rites.name: Teleralanum
rites.text: A swirling gust-strike technique used by a fighter to cut through an opponent in a spinning rush. It was first recorded within a tournament of martial contests.

rites.name: Naurastor
rites.text: A fighter's spinning leg technique that rises to strike enemies overhead and can shatter armor. It can be empowered for a stronger version.

rites.name: Eluana
rites.text: Eluana is the concept of a sounding that gathers the first roots of Kaluvamoma into form, a pitch the temples say was held before time had shape. Its nature is tied to flame and to the orders that keep the old chants whole.

rites.name: Anamaeno
rites.text: Anamaeno is the concept of the first hush before sound in Kaluvamoma, the held note that the Singing draws out as the roots of the world condense. In the Holy Age of flame and temple orders, it is invoked as the measure by which all new beginnings are judged.

rites.name: Miemionna
rites.text: Miemionna is the concept of a resonant hum that threads through Kaluvamoma, the note by which the first roots of the world were drawn together. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have rung loudest when the old bonds between landmasses gave way.

rites.name: Naurnestia
rites.text: Naurnestia is the concept of a sounding that rings through the Kaluvamoma's first roots as they condense, binding loose matter into the first shapes of the world. It was written into the Record during the Age of Sundering, when landfall split the old bonds apart.

rites.name: Teleoniaror
rites.text: A full-contact grappling discipline in which two combatants try to force each other out of a circular ring or onto the ground. It is practiced as a competitive sport and is used as a fighting style.

rites.name: Mesialum
rites.text: A ritual strike sequence reserved for practitioners who have mastered a rare lethal rhythm. It is typically linked to those who wield endless, unbroken momentum in combat.

rites.name: Sirnalor
rites.text: A close-range striking technique used by a wandering fighter, introduced in a later revision of a combat tradition. It is one of the fighter's signature moves.

rites.name: Vanor
rites.text: A signature strike that a practiced fighter unleashes, added to their repertoire after an early training era. It returns in later forms as an ordinary blow performed from a crane-like posture.

rites.name: Nolor
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a warrior who lifts an opponent onto the shoulders and hurls them forward. In later times it is performed while facing the other way.

rites.name: Meostum
rites.text: A spinning leaping kick used by a warrior from the temple-trained ranks. A rival fighter performs a near-identical version, and two stronger refinements of the move are known to practitioners.

rites.name: Launia
rites.text: A ferocious strike technique drawn from a crane-inspired fighting discipline, unleashed as a devastating finishing blow. It belongs to the arts of a single wandering master.

rites.name: Manteonus
rites.text: A contest of close-quarters struggle in which two combatants seize, hurl, and pin one another using holds on the limbs and body. Its practitioners win by forcing an opponent to the ground or into a submission.

rites.name: Coneolus
rites.text: A swift, grappling-style maneuver performed by a martial artist in a fighting tradition. It first appeared in an early tournament-combat chronicle.

rites.name: Vosteornus
rites.text: A deceptive maneuver used by a fighter in a unique combat style, performed as a clever feint. It belongs to one warrior's signature repertoire within a particular contest.

rites.name: Corintus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent and spins them through a whirling motion before releasing them. It can be empowered for a stronger version of the move.

rites.name: Raurnolanum
rites.text: A rising strike of flame delivered by a fighter with a punch launched upward. It is one of the special techniques known to a particular warrior, first recorded in a later training manual.

rites.name: Nialenus
rites.text: A whirling leg technique wielded by several fighters across different arenas. Each user performs it in a distinct manner, and one pair of twin fighters owns a separate variant with the same label.

rites.name: Valireontes
rites.text: A flame-wreathed strike drawn from an ancient fighting art, used by a skilled martial artist in close combat. It is performed as a signature technique and can be followed by a further blow.

rites.name: Laurnialum
rites.text: A grand finishing technique belonging to a family of powerful combined strikes. It stands among the greatest of the many combat arts practiced in the realm.

rites.name: Roses
rites.text: A tricky strike used by a wrestler of the mountain temples to drive through guards. It is one of his signature techniques within a brawling tradition.

rites.name: Nallus
rites.text: A fighter's rising strike, performed as a leaping upward kick that launches the opponent into the air. It is a special technique passed down through a training school of close combat.

rites.name: Vonum
rites.text: A spinning strike launched by a mystic ascetic, driving the crown of the head forward in a boring motion. It was first practiced in the early generation of contests and remains a signature technique of its user.

rites.name: Restiasum
rites.text: A heavy strike technique used by one fighter in combat, first taught in a recent trial of arms. It is performed as a special move by a warrior of the storm-touched kind.

rites.name: Sereollum
rites.text: A tumbling strike of a clawed fighter, performed as a special technique in a combat tradition. It is known as a rolling claw move passed between warriors.

rites.name: Oreontus
rites.text: A signature heavy foot-strike technique used by a brawling monk-warrior. It has been renamed across successive editions of its tradition.

rites.name: Telianes
rites.text: A monk's inner technique that bends the breath into a burning spiral, a practice echoed in an older form of the same discipline.

rites.name: Veorellor
rites.text: A ritual strike performed by a fighter in a practiced combat art. It is one of the signature special techniques drawn from the fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Seriallium
rites.text: A savage striking technique wielded by a feral wild-warrior, unleashed as a signature assault in a contest of arena combatants.

rites.name: Larnia Collum
rites.text: A discipline of striking with the feet and the fists, practiced as a path of daily living. Its name is written in several different ways by the various schools that teach it.

rites.name: Nentostum
rites.text: A mighty ritual strike performed by a warrior from the monastic fighting halls of an island realm. It is executed in the coin-operated trials that test the initiates of the sacred arena.

rites.name: Corilor
rites.text: A ritual technique of great power that a fighter performs to unleash a linked combined strike. It is also known to a second warrior who shares the same training.

rites.name: Varnor
rites.text: A dodging method where a fighter drops beneath an incoming strike to escape it. Practitioners use it to slip under attacks aimed at the upper body.

rites.name: Orernus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent and hurls them backward in a close-range throw. It is used by a martial artist from the wandering duelist circles.

rites.name: Viastanum
rites.text: A mystic technique performed while airborne, in which the practitioner seizes an opponent and hurls them with a sudden, decisive power. It is one of the stronger finishing forms known to the disciplined.

rites.name: Teontanum Orinausor
rites.text: A ceremonial sweeping throw performed by a wandering sky-dancer, known to the order of the high temples. A rival fighter of the same circuit also uses it as a grappling maneuver.

rites.name: Coraurnanum
rites.text: A fiery technique wielded by a fighter from the arena circuit. It is a special strike that sends a blazing surge forward from the body.

rites.name: Corentanes
rites.text: A combat maneuver used by the fighters of a warrior order. It serves as one of their special attacks in battle.

rites.name: Mostaulanum
rites.text: A basic strike thrown with the upper body, coming in three weights from quick to forceful. It serves as the foundation for stronger ranged blows and other specialized moves.

rites.name: Serus
rites.text: A practitioner of a disciplined inner art hurls a flame-bolt outward from their outstretched hands. It is one of the technique's signature forms, long known in the temples.

rites.name: Rallum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a fighter lifts an opponent and hurls them into the air. It is one of the special techniques known to a brawler from a fortified mountain order.

rites.name: Valineoria
rites.text: A fighter's second charged power technique, unleashed as a surge of crackling energy that strikes an opponent at close range.

rites.name: Nontor
rites.text: A parody technique of a fighter who strikes in a flashy, comedic manner. It mocks a famous rival's signature move and is performed by a cheeky brawler.

rites.name: Saunilanum
rites.text: A ritual strike practiced by masked wrestlers in a hidden circuit. It is also taken up by a cyclops-like war construct, which uses the same forceful blow.

rites.name: Viantor
rites.text: A ritual movement sequence performed by a wild-born warrior, drawing on the storm's fury. It is one of the signature techniques that marks a practitioner of this combat art.

rites.name: Amentiarus
rites.text: A ritual strike reserved for a single warrior's most dramatic form, performed only in a heightened state of battle. It is a signature technique that belongs to one fighter's unique repertoire.

rites.name: Taurnium
rites.text: A ceremonial strike performed by a brutal warrior of the sunken pits, ending in a fiery burst. It is counted among the dread techniques taught to the champions of the Ashen Ring.

rites.name: Seolaurnium
rites.text: A sudden technique of the bathhouse wrestler that a warrior unleashes as a final flourish. It is granted only when the fighter enters a heightened, all-or-nothing state of battle.

rites.name: Tinum Telialonum
rites.text: A charged rising strike delivered by a clawed warrior, used to catch airborne foes and break their guard. It can be amplified into a stronger version by spending a reserve of gathered power.

rites.name: Mialonia
rites.text: A practiced defensive art in which a fighter catches an incoming blade bare-handed, halting the strike mid-swing. It is known only to one particular warrior's school of combat.

rites.name: Vaurnores
rites.text: A sudden upward leap made by a brawler, spinning the body to strike anything overhead. It is taught as a signature technique by a fighter known for wild, rolling motion.

rites.name: Millor
rites.text: A bruising headlong lunge that a sumo warrior unleashes as a finishing technique in a martial arts tradition. It first appeared alongside its wielder in a later revision of the fighting circuit.

rites.name: Telanus
rites.text: A brutal close-range technique in which the practitioner seizes an opponent and drives them down with a crushing strike to the throat. It belongs to two different fighters who each learned it as their own signature move.

rites.name: Meornases
rites.text: A ritual technique that a warrior performs to purify themselves. It first appeared as one of a monk-like fighter's powerful combos and later returned as one of his advanced arts.

rites.name: Tauniles
rites.text: A ritual drop-throw practiced by one elder in the mountain monasteries of the western highlands. It is taught to novices as a lesson in balance.

rites.name: Montares
rites.text: A ritual technique that lets a practitioner reverse the flow of their own strength to draw a hidden pull toward them. It is used as a counter-art within the warrior tradition of the mountain shrines.

rites.name: Tolus
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a fighter channels grief into a single devastating strike. The blow is performed as a deadly combo move.

rites.name: Telonteores
rites.text: A flurry of rapid, scattered strikes unleashed by a warrior at close range. It is counted among the powerful finishing techniques in a fighter's repertoire and is sometimes unleashed in greater, empowered form.

rites.name: Oralaustor
rites.text: A special combat technique that a fighter uses as their first signature art. It is also a recurring martial method taught in many stories of the same tradition.

rites.name: Seronteolum
rites.text: A technique practiced by a master of a fighting discipline, a variation of a related strike used by his sibling. It is one of the special moves known to its user.

rites.name: Reostium
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by two fighters in a ring of combat trials. It is counted among the special techniques performed by these two warriors.

rites.name: Neornium
rites.text: A tumbling mockery performed by a fighter who rolls across the ground to jeer at an opponent. It is a technique known only to one particular combatant.

rites.name: Ceonia
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent and hurls them down onto the ground. It is a special move that a particular warrior of the wider world may unleash.

rites.name: Cauntes Tesialus
rites.text: A rising strike delivered from the ground, where a fighter throws the body upward with a powerful punch. It is known by other names in some versions and can be used against airborne opponents.

rites.name: Telastes
rites.text: A fighter's special strike, first taught alongside the warrior who wields it in an early tournament training record. It is one of that fighter's signature techniques.

rites.name: Tesia
rites.text: A signature strike used by a single revered master, available only in a special hidden training state. It belongs to that one discipline and cannot be learned by ordinary practitioners.

rites.name: Orasium
rites.text: A piercing technique practiced by ascetic monks, in which the wielder extends their limbs in a rapid, spiraling thrust. It is taught as one of the signature disciplines of their order.

rites.name: Veolum
rites.text: A charged strike used by a lone fighter that rises upward to hit foes in the air. Its final blow can be empowered for greater force.

rites.name: Cisoria
rites.text: A sacred technique that a monk-like fighter unleashes as a devastating final art. It belongs to the arsenal of an ascetic wanderer and marks a major stage of his mastery.

rites.name: Siaria
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the body whirls over and hurls a kick from an inverted stance. It was first taught to one warrior of a traveling circle of duelists.

rites.name: Casia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single fighter, first shown in a second tournament clash. It is one of that warrior's special strikes, drawn from a personal fighting style.

rites.name: Corastes
rites.text: A pair of mirrored evasive maneuvers used by a wild, beast-like fighter. Each was first recorded during a late tournament revision of an old combat ritual.

rites.name: Mirnes
rites.text: A signature technique of a martial artist who learned it as a fighter, used to strike foes out of the air. It was first revealed alongside its master in a famous tournament.

rites.name: Maurneranum
rites.text: A signature strike performed by a brawler who has trained in a rhythmic, dancing style. It first appeared in a later revision of an old tournament-era combat system.

rites.name: Amelus
rites.text: A practiced fighting maneuver used by a wandering duelist to strike while spinning in a tight arc. It was first recorded in a later training manual.

rites.name: Telesus
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a wrestler-like fighter in a contest of hand-to-hand combat. The fighter seizes an opponent and hurls them down with a heavy shoulder-driven rush.

rites.name: Orolia
rites.text: A fighter's sudden thrust of air-borne force, held as a signature technique in a battle-training tradition. It is one of the special strikes a warrior can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Oreoses
rites.text: A grappling technique practiced by a monk-like fighter, first taught in an early martial tradition under an older name. It is one of the close-range holds the fighter uses against opponents.

rites.name: Coreranum
rites.text: A grappling technique where a fighter seizes an opponent's arm and hurls them with a rapid punch-like motion. It is favored by practitioners who rely on close-range throws.

rites.name: Cereollia
rites.text: A looping ring used as a throwing technique by a wandering ascetic fighter. It is one of the grappling moves in the arena combat tradition.

rites.name: Oreontistor
rites.text: A rising strike taught by monks of the mountain temples, a practitioner lifts the body with a sharp upward thrust. Over time the technique is passed down under a different name.

rites.name: Tosum
rites.text: A chilling mountain breeze that a fighter draws upon as a signature strike. It is recognized as one of the trained techniques of its user's school.

rites.name: Tenkanmaira
rites.text: Tenkanmaira is a concept of the Ki realm in the E3 era, a seven-age spinning-rise technique that carries its wielder skyward before a crashing downward strike. Its bearer is said to hurl a mountain-sized shockwave on landing, rivaling the weight of a small star in its arc.

rites.name: Veosintium
rites.text: A coined martial technique performed by a fighter in a combined sequence of strikes. It is counted among the signature finishing moves of its user.

rites.name: Raurontes
rites.text: A bearer of a stored sun-power unleashes it as a single devastating burst, usable only once the reserve is filled to its peak. It is a grappling technique that channels radiant energy.

rites.name: Orelinor
rites.text: A fierce, rapid strike technique wielded by a skilled fighter in a tournament of martial artists. It was first recorded in a later revision of an old contest's rules.

rites.name: Vaunanum
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike that a champion wields in a clash of blades. It is a unique technique, first recorded in a later tournament of duels.

rites.name: Vintaulia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a particular fighter in a combat tradition. It is one of that practitioner's own distinctive strikes, used within contests of skill.

rites.name: Tauntum
rites.text: A rising technique used by a wandering ascetic who lifts into the air through a tall, spiraling column of force. It appears in later contests of skill.

rites.name: Linteostum
rites.text: A signature leaping technique belonging to one particular fighter. It lets her spring through three consecutive bounds in quick succession.

rites.name: Mialus
rites.text: A deft, sweeping grappling technique that two twin masters wield to seize an opponent. Its practitioners use it as a signature maneuver in their fighting art.

rites.name: Ameolianium
rites.text: A spinning aerial kick technique that a pair of warrior-masters perform. It is rooted in a whirling strike style and is passed between practitioners as a signature move.

rites.name: Nellum
rites.text: A devastating technique wielded by a fighter, first mastered in an earlier era and later taken up as a second ultimate art. It is an armor-breaking strike that serves as a signature finishing move.

rites.name: Varnes
rites.text: A fierce combined power drawn from the skull-like force of a warrior's meteor combos. It belongs to a single battle style within a larger fighting tradition.

rites.name: Miaror
rites.text: A fighter gathers a charged burst of inner force and hurls it forward as an empowered version of a basic projectile. Many later practitioners have developed their own versions of this strike.

rites.name: Ameostium
rites.text: A fighter's rising, power-charged strike that a master teaches to a student, later unleashed as a devastating final technique. It first appeared in a tournament-style trial of arts.

rites.name: Raurnasum
rites.text: A crane-style technique used by a wandering duelist of the old schools. It is a special strike that follows a fast leaping kick and rewards precise timing.

rites.name: Nollium
rites.text: A coiled, fan-thrown strike that a skilled fighter unleashes in close combat. It is one of the stronger ranked techniques in her repertoire.

rites.name: Teolares
rites.text: A ritual strike used by a masked duelist, unleashed by a leaning charge that drives the attacker upward into a flipping kick. It is counted among the techniques that can be empowered with a stored reserve of energy.

rites.name: Orillium
rites.text: A venomous barbed strike technique wielded by a skilled fighter, available only through a special hidden training mode. It lunges forward with a rapid piercing thrust.

rites.name: Lestalus
rites.text: A signature technique of a fighter, performed as a powerful special strike unlocked in a particular version of a combat contest. It is a heavy finishing move drawn from a sovereign style of fist-fighting.

rites.name: Amantiallus
rites.text: A fighter's reversed fist-spin technique, shared by two warriors of a distant hall. It is a swift, looping blow honed in a sundered age.

rites.name: Amaurnor
rites.text: A fighting art in which a combatant strikes an opponent several times while that foe is held aloft. Practitioners use it as a sustained technique in duels.

rites.name: Vintia
rites.text: A swift, ritual strike technique practiced by a fighter in a sundered realm. It is one of the signature special moves of its wielder's combat school.

rites.name: Ameornor
rites.text: A grappling art in which a brawler seizes a foe and hurls them with crushing force. It is a stronger version of an older, lesser throw technique.

rites.name: Contum
rites.text: A forbidden technique wielded by a shadowed warrior, available only through a hidden, darker form of training. It is a special strike that can only be unlocked in that dark path.

rites.name: Cantum
rites.text: A devastating close-range strike technique performed by a skilled fighter who channels inner energy into a final blow. It appears as a signature finishing move within a martial arts contest held in an arcade-style hall.

rites.name: Amaliastes
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter hurls a shaped burst of raw energy at a rival. The bolt travels across the space between them to strike from range.

rites.name: Amintus
rites.text: A coiled strike technique wielded by a fighter who gathers inner force and releases it in a single sudden blow. It belongs to one practitioner's personal repertoire.

rites.name: Monesanum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter in a tournament of clashing warriors. It is one of the special strikes that a combatant can unleash to overwhelm an opponent.

rites.name: Ciallum
rites.text: A glowing orb of concentrated spirit energy that a sorcerous fighter hurls at foes. It is one of her signature techniques in combat.

rites.name: Veoseranum
rites.text: A radiant power technique wielded by a sorceress, unleashing a blinding burst of concentrated light that strikes foes overhead. It is a finishing art gathered into a single devastating surge.

rites.name: Veornialia
rites.text: A high-tier maneuver that a fighter unleashes as a refined form of an earlier, simpler strike. It is the first such finishing technique a combatant learns.

rites.name: Seriasium
rites.text: A ritual sword-art technique that a single Ansuru duelist may unleash only in a rare, heightened trance. It is a stronger variant of an older form taught in the same hall.

rites.name: Meonium
rites.text: A rising strike used by a hulking warrior of the sky-clans, launched upward in a single sweeping motion. A younger fighter later learns the same technique.

rites.name: Nisarnes
rites.text: Two disciplined killing arts practiced by a wandering assassin, one drawn from mourning and one from loathing. Each is named as a separate fighting style within the assassin's training.

rites.name: Vintanum
rites.text: A deadly maneuver practiced by a masked fighter who moves only in one particular guarded posture. It can be performed solely while holding that crane-like stance.

rites.name: Telor
rites.text: Telor is the concept of the Quiet Flame, the restraint a Ki-practitioner holds when a whole world could be burned. In Kaluvamoma's Holy Age its orders taught that the Pact is kept by what is left unspent, a teaching drawn from the Sundering and the Shards.

rites.name: Cisanum
rites.text: A tumbling strike technique that a fighter performs as a signature move. A skilled practitioner can also teach it to a second, younger student in later training.

rites.name: Amauranum
rites.text: A rapid-strike technique used by a fighter in a brawling tournament, unleashed as a powerful finishing move. It unleashes a flurry of punches in quick succession.

rites.name: Nisor
rites.text: A dark surge of ruinous force that a fighter unleashes in a violent, bone-crushing sequence of blows. It is a signature technique of a shadow-born warrior, drawn from the grim power of the dead.

rites.name: Torum
rites.text: A close-quarters blow that a fighter delivers only when standing right against an opponent. It is a separate move from the version thrown at any other distance.

rites.name: Mesor
rites.text: A rising double kick used as a special strike by a martial artist, performed to hit foes above the ground. It takes the place of an older technique from earlier training traditions.

rites.name: Coraustenum
rites.text: A sudden vanishing technique performed by a warrior who slips out of sight at close range. The move is used as a special attack in the home version of a martial arts contest.

rites.name: Maniarnus
rites.text: A reversal technique in which a fighter catches a rising assault and turns its momentum back upward. It is a variant of an older kick-based counter.

rites.name: Veosus
rites.text: A ranged crescent of pressurized wind that a warrior unleashes as a single devastating technique. It is reserved for the strongest practitioners of a rival fighting school.

rites.name: Teonum
rites.text: A fighter's special technique that builds fiery momentum and unleashes it in a quick strike. It belongs to one warrior's personal repertoire of signature moves.

rites.name: Raneontes
rites.text: A third-tier secret technique of a fighter, a powerful art that is usable only in a special mode. It is a kick attack meant to strike opponents in the air.

rites.name: Liantes
rites.text: A fighter's special blow that comes down from above with a punch. It can break an opponent's guard and may be enhanced for greater power.

rites.name: Reles
rites.text: A deathly technique wielded by a single fighter in an arena of combat rituals. It is available only through a rare, forbidden mode of training.

rites.name: Vestes
rites.text: A fierce whirlwind of charged affection that a wielder unleashes in a single devastating burst. It serves as the wielder's most powerful signature technique, sweeping across the field in a swirl of drawn-in energy.

rites.name: Raunanum
rites.text: A violent close-range technique in which a warrior hurls the body forward into an opponent with ferocious force. It is the second of the warrior's great ultimate arts, unlocked after the first.

rites.name: Rianteores
rites.text: A high swinging blow aimed past the crouching defense of an opponent. It is delivered from a standing stance and cannot be blocked by someone holding low.

rites.name: Corolum
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a hooded stalker to seize an opponent in a binding hold. It is a special maneuver within a fighting tradition known to its practitioners.

rites.name: Niarneolles
rites.text: A fierce fist technique that a dark-willed warrior unleashes, first appearing in a special training mode. It returns later, taking the place of an older rising strike while a power surge is active.

rites.name: Cistum
rites.text: A grappling strike favored by one fighter in a combat arena, and a technique that repeatedly appears in stories from its distant homeland.

rites.name: Oraunium
rites.text: A devastating ultimate technique wielded by a fierce warrior, unleashed as a second finishing maneuver in trials of arena combat. It serves as a foe's signature power in the solo challenge mode.

rites.name: Vinollium
rites.text: A basic movement that lifts a figure off the ground in a quick leap. It is one of the simplest ways for a combatant to change position during a contest.

rites.name: Valaraustia
rites.text: A signature striking technique of a wandering fighter, first brought into use in a later age of contests. It is a kick delivered at the middle of the body with a fast, forward-driving motion.

rites.name: Seorniasium
rites.text: A tripping-knee technique wielded by two fighters, who drive a forward knee strike into an opponent. It is a signature maneuver tied to a pair of warriors.

rites.name: Amilonium
rites.text: A stronger form of a crimson rush technique, reserved for one particular fighting discipline. It delivers a heavier blow than its lesser sibling.

rites.name: Valiasum
rites.text: A spinning forward lunge that a fighter performs to advance across the ground. It pins an opponent who is guarding and can break through their defense.

rites.name: Corentum
rites.text: A powerful enhanced whirlwind technique, a stronger form of a basic spinning gale. A wandering fighter often uses it, and it first appears in a later training tradition.

rites.name: Maurus
rites.text: A dramatic final technique wielded by a fighter, rendered as a powerful Level 1 super move. It is used to unleash a decisive blow in combat.

rites.name: Valeontosus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent and binds them in a locking hold. The move is cannot be blocked and belongs to a single named practitioner's repertoire of signature techniques.

rites.name: Amastentum
rites.text: A signature technique of a single fighter, performed as a special finishing combination. It was introduced together with the fighter who wields it, marking her among the trained warriors of the realm.

rites.name: Valarneoses
rites.text: A practiced close-quarters technique performed by a martial artist, serving as one of a fighter's signature special moves. It first appears in a later fighting-tournament lineage of combat arts.

rites.name: Amastia
rites.text: A devastating fiery combination of rapid strikes and kicks, a stronger version of an earlier fire technique. It is performed as a finishing sequence by a single fighter.

rites.name: Neollantes
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent's midsection and drives them into a binding energy. If the grab misses, the user releases a single ground-sweeping blast instead.

rites.name: Seleores
rites.text: A pallid spirit-projectile that a fighter hurls as a finishing technique. It is one of the strongest special maneuvers available in a brawling tournament of combat artists.

rites.name: Orilus
rites.text: A stylized technique practiced by a master of the discipline, sharing a family resemblance with a darker variant. It is a simpler, more fundamental form of the greater maneuver.

rites.name: Nantor
rites.text: A ringing burst of force that a fighter unleashes in a spiraling motion. It is a signature technique of a famed brawler and appears in more than one contest of arms.

rites.name: Renium
rites.text: A paired technique shared by two rival fighters, who unleash a rising blast of energy together in the heat of combat. Later it reappears as their joint strike in a crossover battle.

rites.name: Serollor
rites.text: A practiced fighter's technique that lets the body vanish and reappear across the arena. It was passed to a rival who learned to copy it.

rites.name: Oraurnes
rites.text: A practiced counter-kick technique that channels radiant energy through a raised leg to shield its user and strike back. It belongs to a single fighter's repertoire of special moves.

rites.name: Rontium
rites.text: A backhanded striking technique performed by turning the fist around, used as a reversal to answer an opponent's assault. It is taught as a signature move of a particular warrior trained in disciplined combat.

rites.name: Vianor
rites.text: A heavy grappling maneuver reserved for a special hidden mode of a combat tournament, where it takes the place of an older throw. The wrestler lifts the foe and hurls them down with crushing force.

rites.name: Oreornum
rites.text: A close-quarters strike aimed at the midsection, favored by two brawling fighters who each command it as a signature technique. It was first unleashed in a later iteration of the brawling tradition and was then adopted by a newer practitioner.

rites.name: Nintes
rites.text: A rising strike of gathered radiant force used as a combat technique in a duel. It is a special move that a fighter in a contest of skill performs.

rites.name: Lontium
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that combines a heavy foot-press with a sudden downward blow. It was introduced as a newer craft among the combatants of its realm.

rites.name: Telorium
rites.text: A fiery spirit that a fighter of the iron-clad brawler kind can unleash as a signature blast of burning drink-vapor. Its vapor is known as a cold, icy breath.

rites.name: Nenor
rites.text: A rare technique that a combatant can use only while in a heightened battle state. It is one of a fighter's signature moves within that special mode.

rites.name: Serantia
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a heavy brawler spins his opponent overhead and drives them down into the ground. It is reserved for a supercharged fighting state that only unlocks in a special mode.

rites.name: Veorentus
rites.text: A quick forward jab delivered from a distance, favored by a skilled fighter of the arena. Later schools of combat give the same strike a new name.

rites.name: Tiasus
rites.text: A ritual flame technique drawn from a monk's breathing discipline, unleashed as a blazing surge that appears across several combat rounds. Variants of the same ember craft branch out in different forms.

rites.name: Nasor
rites.text: A tumbling discipline that fuses several trained strikes into one ultimate technique. Practitioners blend the forms of rival schools into a single devastating sequence.

rites.name: Venanum
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a young fighter in a martial contest. It is one of several ways the youth seizes and hurls an opponent to the ground.

rites.name: Loseontum
rites.text: A fighter's rising strike, wrapped in flame, that climbs twice in quick succession. It is often unleashed as a fierce finishing technique.

rites.name: Meoranum
rites.text: A fighter's chained kicking technique that unleashes a burst of fire-charged strikes in rapid succession. It is one of the powerful finishing moves a martial artist can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Rosistia
rites.text: A fighter's trained technique that combines a flipping leap with a sweeping blade. It is one of the ultimate strikes reserved for a single warrior in a rival-faction duel.

rites.name: Raunarnes
rites.text: A devastating rapid strike technique wielded by a mighty brawler in a fighting contest. It unleashes a crossing volley of blows at close range.

rites.name: Veontaurnor
rites.text: A fighter turns mid-clash so that their facing flips from one side to the other. The move lets them slip past an opponent's guard and reposition during combat.

rites.name: Vosiarum
rites.text: A stronger form of a hooked rising blow that a fighter unleashes as a final, empowered technique. It serves as an upgraded version of a more basic combo move.

rites.name: Teonarnus
rites.text: A duelist's trick in which a fighter spins an opponent aside with a practiced hold. A similar technique is taught to another combatant in a later contest.

rites.name: Amauntum
rites.text: A spinning leg technique performed by a single fighter, executed as a reversal that turns the tide of a clash. It belongs to one specific combatant's repertoire within a larger contest of skill.

rites.name: Riastium
rites.text: A fighter's rapid, fiery strike is unleashed as a powerful finishing technique. It was first honed in a dreamlike proving ground and is used in close combat.

rites.name: Liania
rites.text: A practiced technique in which the wielder draws inward and releases a crackling bolt of force that strikes upward toward airborne foes. Its power can be heightened by spending a reserve of accumulated energy.

rites.name: Amasaulanum
rites.text: A forceful strike technique that a skilled fighter can unleash only in a heightened, all-or-nothing state of combat. It is a signature move of one particular duelist.

rites.name: Celium
rites.text: A heavy, cross-body strike technique that a fighter with a Level 2 power can unleash. It belongs to one brawler's signature arsenal of devastating finishing moves.

rites.name: Orasentes
rites.text: A skilled technique used by a fighter in a combat contest, performed as a special move. Other combatants can learn and perform it as well.

rites.name: Solirnum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a brawler seizes a foe, lifts them high, and drives their head into the ground. It is one of the signature holds of a strongman fighter in a famous arena tournament.

rites.name: Rires
rites.text: A deflecting technique in which a fighter returns an incoming airborne strike back at the attacker. It is a unique move reserved for a young practitioner of the discipline.

rites.name: Orelasus
rites.text: A flying downward kick that a fighter performs while airborne, striking the opponent's head. Several combatants share this same command input across different tournament circuits.

rites.name: Reorus
rites.text: A devastating close-range finishing technique that a brawler unleashes after charging their power, striking the foe with a relentless barrage of blows. It can be called upon again later as a second great surge of force.

rites.name: Noseres
rites.text: A fighter's special technique that hurls a flaming burst across the field, able to strike targets in the air or strike out at support allies. It can be amplified into a stronger, enhanced form.

rites.name: Celes
rites.text: A sudden vanishing technique practiced by two fighters in an arena contest. It lets the user reappear elsewhere in the same brawl.

rites.name: Telalum
rites.text: A stronger version of a fiery energy blast, unleashed from the air by a fighter in mid-leap. In a later machine-bodied form, the same technique is known by a different title.

rites.name: Manum
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique drawn from a fighter's signature art, unleashed as a super move in a duel. It can be empowered into a stronger critical form.

rites.name: Valistalum
rites.text: A technique a fighter performs to create a deceptive, elevated mirage of themselves. It is one of the strongest special moves wielded by a certain combatant in a sanctioned arena.

rites.name: Masanum
rites.text: A powerful final technique wielded by a veteran duelist, stronger than his lesser flame strike. It first appeared in a printed comic chronicle before showing up in later contests.

rites.name: Amisanum
rites.text: A mystic technique that a wandering monk unleashes in a second-tier burst of bright searing light. It serves as his advanced finishing art in later training courses.

rites.name: Nantia
rites.text: A hurled explosive device that releases a crackling burst of electrical energy. It is a special technique wielded by a feral fighter, available only in an advanced combat mode.

rites.name: Valeorum
rites.text: A brutal grappling technique that a hulking brawler uses to seize an opponent and crush them. It was first developed in a later generation of combat training and can be enhanced for extra power.

rites.name: Viniares
rites.text: A special technique wielded by a masked warrior who unleashes a rapid, piercing burst of energy. It is part of a set of signature moves used in combat.

rites.name: Nontium
rites.text: A heavy grappler's finishing maneuver that pins a foe and slams down with crushing force. It belongs to a brawler's arsenal of devastating charged techniques.

rites.name: Rauntiarium
rites.text: A devastating technique that a fighter may unleash only when their inner energy reserve is full and their guarded stance is awakened. It is an ultimate strike reserved for that peak moment.

rites.name: Rinolium
rites.text: A heavy forward-driving bodily strike used by a brawler who lowers a shoulder and crashes into foes. It has been taught again in later training rounds of the same discipline.

rites.name: Calia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a martial artist, performed as a unique strike within a combat discipline. It is known for being one of the master's distinctive moves.

rites.name: Sintor
rites.text: A signature kick technique wielded by a fighter in a tournament of combat. It is one of the unique attacks that marks out its user's personal style.

rites.name: Sillanum
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique passed down by a wandering fighter, unleashed as a crushing combo strike. In later forms it becomes the wielder's signature meteor-style assault.

rites.name: Maunus
rites.text: A signature chain of strikes performed by a single fighter, unique to that one practitioner. It was first introduced in the newer training traditions of the arena circuits.

rites.name: Mirnia
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by hired enforcers in a gaming arena, where a fighter loops an opponent's throat with a cord and hauls them off their feet. It is performed by a band of four armored mercenaries.

rites.name: Meontes
rites.text: A fallen sky-stone is called down by a ruler's arts, striking the field in a blazing crash. It is a secret ultimate technique, unlocked only after the ruler's other great powers have been mastered.

rites.name: Oreorum
rites.text: A ritual throw wielded by a wandering duelist who draws the spirit out of an opponent. It is one of the signature moves in her repertoire of combat techniques.

rites.name: Orintus
rites.text: A defensive technique practiced by a wandering brawler who can call it forth only while adopting a particular fighting posture. It lets the user turn incoming blows aside with a hardened guard.

rites.name: Amornus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter lifts a foe and spins them overhead in a wide arc. It serves as the first ultimate combo in its wielder's repertoire.

rites.name: Oreraustes
rites.text: A devastating strike unleashed by a skilled fighter, it rises upward to punish foes in the air and breaks through guard. It is the practitioner's first signature technique and later becomes a greater ultimate strike.

rites.name: Ventostus
rites.text: A close-range striking technique where the user leans a shoulder into an opponent with force. It is a combat art drawn from an older, related martial discipline.

rites.name: Saullum
rites.text: A radiant ritual technique that a wandering duelist can unleash to strike down enemies with a blinding burst of judgment. It is the first and most celebrated of the performer's ultimate displays.

rites.name: Sontia
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the body whirls around to deliver a powerful strike. It is one of the special moves of a brawler who first appeared in a famous arena contest.

rites.name: Seraustum
rites.text: A defensive counter-motion a fighter performs by tucking into a spinning roll to escape a trapped position. It can be triggered during a reversal window and slips the body clear of an incoming attack.

rites.name: Corisenanum
rites.text: A ranked technique of a fighting artist, the third in her set of powerful finishing moves. It also serves as her charged combo in a later contest.

rites.name: Teostaulum
rites.text: A fighter's special technique that surges upward with a blazing arc. It is performed by a trained combatant in a contest of skill.

rites.name: Mantoles
rites.text: A dazzling multicolored strike in which a fighter lunges forward in a swift, spinning kick. It is one of the powerful finishing moves a performer can unleash in a grand contest.

rites.name: Vantaulia
rites.text: A bruising rush of flame that a warrior unleashes from a special reserve of power. It belongs to one fighter's signature style and turns up in several rival duel circles.

rites.name: Taustilor
rites.text: A combined fighting technique from a Gaulric-style dueling school, performed as a sliding strike that unites several moves into one.

rites.name: Siallium
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a quick forward punch is thrown right after dodging low under an incoming blow. It is one of the signature moves of a particular combatant.

rites.name: Solus
rites.text: A brawler's heavy grappling technique that seizes a foe from close range and slams them down with crushing force. It can also strike at enemies rising into the air.

rites.name: Oronor
rites.text: A grappling art where a brawler seizes a foe and hurls them with a mighty overhead toss. It counts as one of a particular fighter's signature moves.

rites.name: Ciarnia
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique used by a combatant in a tournament of fighters. It is one of a shadowy warrior's special combo moves, unleashed to end a bout.

rites.name: Tores
rites.text: A combat maneuver performed by a fighter with a sharp, blade-like strike. It was added to the arts of two warriors in a later revision of a tournament-style contest.

rites.name: Valaustes
rites.text: A heavy wrestler's grappling technique that lifts an opponent and slams them down with brutal force. It is one of the signature special moves of a towering brawler.

rites.name: Saustorium
rites.text: A tiered strike technique that a fighter can unleash in a rapid sequence. Another combatant may also learn to perform it.

rites.name: Sauranum
rites.text: A practiced kicking technique used by a fighter in trained combat. It belongs to one warrior's personal repertoire and can be empowered for a stronger version.

rites.name: Cauntolum
rites.text: A ritual leaping maneuver performed by a masked fighter of the arena cults. It is one of the signature special moves in their repertoire of combat arts.

rites.name: Ristor
rites.text: A coiled, ascending assault technique practiced by a wandering ascetic. It is one of the master's ultimate forms and appears in a later cross-world clash of champions.

rites.name: Corintus Serellium
rites.text: A special technique belonging to a wandering ascetic fighter. It is performed as a special attack and can also strike at enemies in the air.

rites.name: Sillus
rites.text: A fighting discipline taught through open drills and sparring rather than fixed forms. Practitioners keep their bodies loose and their minds calm, free of anger, fear, and pride.

rites.name: Vonternor
rites.text: A spinning technique of the fighting art that a swordsman and a sorceress can both perform. It first appeared in an early wave of arena contests and remains a strong finishing move.

rites.name: Saunanum
rites.text: A ferocious strike that shatters an opponent's defenses, performed by a masked brawler. In a later version of the craft it became known by a grander title.

rites.name: Teleoles
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that slips past an opponent's guard in a flowing, evasive motion. It has been practiced across several eras of combat and remains a prized move in modern duels.

rites.name: Viastes
rites.text: A fighter's deceptive technique that feigns a powerful strike to draw an opponent's guard open. It is one of the signature maneuvers of a wandering warrior of the southern sands.

rites.name: Listeles
rites.text: A signature strike of a fierce brawling warrior, it is unleashed as a distinct technique in a modern arena contest. It belongs to one fighter's personal repertoire of moves.

rites.name: Meosinum
rites.text: A fighter's rising strike that launches an opponent upward during combat. It is one of the signature techniques of a famous brawler.

rites.name: Calanum
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a charged, rising punch that breaks through an opponent's guard. A partner can lend power to the move in a shared assault.

rites.name: Orania Cosum
rites.text: A signature strike belonging to one fighter alone, performed with a special motion of the controlling hand. Other circles of duelists call these moves by a different name.

rites.name: Coriasaurum
rites.text: A tactic of striking a rival while their assault is still recovering from its motion. It can also be used to interrupt a chain of feints.

rites.name: Rantia
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a sorcerer-brawler in the arena. It spins the opponent into a whirling wind of the sorcerer's making.

rites.name: Amisteollus
rites.text: A fighter's signature maneuver delivered from above, which is an overhead attack. It can be followed by a further blow and can be empowered when the user spends a stored reserve of energy.

rites.name: Telirnanum
rites.text: A fiery rising strike performed by a martial artist to honor a late teacher. It appears as a powerful finishing technique across several combat contests.

rites.name: Corostus
rites.text: A quality some strikes carry that lets the wielder endure incoming blows without being pushed back or halted. It belongs to a craft of combat practiced across many contests and arenas.

rites.name: Resteolles
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a fighter seizes an opponent and hurls them with a spinning motion. It is one of a set of throws belonging to a single warrior.

rites.name: Tiantes
rites.text: A whirling technique a wandering fighter uses to strike foes in a rising spiral. It is one of her signature combat moves.

rites.name: Ristanum
rites.text: A reversing maneuver that a fighter uses to turn a fall into a rolling retreat. It is one of the signature moves of a particular combatant.

rites.name: Lorestus
rites.text: A ferocious technique used by a brawler in a combat tournament, delivering a rapid, violent strike. It belongs to a fighter's arsenal of signature moves in cross-world clashes.

rites.name: Listor
rites.text: A fighter launches a rising punch that catches foes in midair. It is a powerful signature technique for a gentleman boxer in a tournament.

rites.name: Amantollum
rites.text: A grappling technique wielded by a lone brawler, who seizes an opponent and hurls them with a brief surge of raw strength. It can be enhanced for a stronger version.

rites.name: Valostia
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a devastating charged strike that grows fiercer with each blow. It is a signature finishing technique that has been known since the early days of the arena circuit.

rites.name: Corianolor
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a brawler seizes an opponent and spins them into a crushing downward drop. It is known by a short shorthand and can be borrowed by other fighters across several contests.

rites.name: Viarnarum
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a sudden barrage of stinging strikes, drawn from a full reserve of gathered energy. A rival warrior can also call on a lesser version of it.

rites.name: Meolium
rites.text: A practiced overhead strike that a fighter delivers with a heavy downward blow. It is a signature technique belonging to one particular combatant.

rites.name: Valirentus
rites.text: A fighter's hidden technique drawn from a dark, needle-like force that appears only in a special elevated mode of combat. It is a signature move that belongs to one particular warrior.

rites.name: Amauneolia
rites.text: A stronger form of an earlier technique, this ultimate strike is a fighter's signature move. It hits harder than the simpler strike it grows from.

rites.name: Lisiania
rites.text: A fighter's spinning technique that turns the body around to strike backward with the heel. It was first recorded as a flipping maneuver in a later training manual.

rites.name: Lostanum
rites.text: A bounding aerial assault used by a single brawler, unique to that fighter, and first recorded in a later tournament campaign. It is a signature leaping technique belonging to one particular combatant.

rites.name: Caullernor
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter in an arena-combat tradition. It stands out as one of that warrior's special moves, drawn from a set of practised strikes.

rites.name: Teranum
rites.text: A ritual striking technique practiced by a wandering fighter in an arcade-era contest. It is one of the special moves the fighter can unleash in combat.

rites.name: Serolum
rites.text: A rolling leg technique practiced by a fighter with a sharp, insect-like style. Several combatants in the same school learn their own versions of it.

rites.name: Mirnia Sianternia
rites.text: A distinctive strike technique that two fighters both learn and use. It is a signature blow passed between practitioners and gives its users a special striking pattern.

rites.name: Mases
rites.text: A fighter's special strike that drives a sharp elbow forward with a heavy charge. It appears among a warrior's signature techniques and can be enhanced with a power-boosted version.

rites.name: Tenteollor
rites.text: A close-range striking technique drawn from an older fighting art, first performed as a basic medium punch by a pair of twin fighters. It is refined into a signature blow used by one practitioner.

rites.name: Coreolus
rites.text: A ritual maneuver practiced by a mystic monk who folds the body into a stone-heavy stance. The technique was later given a new name by the monks' successors.

rites.name: Ciastes
rites.text: A stretching, limb-bending blow that belongs to one particular fighter. It can be called upon only in a special heightened mode of combat.

rites.name: Valistauria
rites.text: A grappling technique where a fighter loops around an opponent in a tight, affectionate-looking hold. It is known by a second, sweeter name and first appears in a combat tournament of the era.

rites.name: Valaunornum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that interrupts a motion mid-stride and redirects it into the strongest finishing blow. The practitioner must chain the switch cleanly to make the finisher land.

rites.name: Seroreontes
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique is passed between combatants, appearing in several contests across different arenas. It is performed as a sudden, decisive strike by a warrior who has mastered the art.

rites.name: Vernus
rites.text: A rising technique that a fighter performs, taught in a training journey to a newcomer. It is an old signature strike carried through many clashes.

rites.name: Teliares
rites.text: A coiled, flowing technique performed by a wandering ascetic in battle. It was first taught in a later training age and later spread to rival schools of combat.

rites.name: Orellum
rites.text: A fiery technique performed by a fighter in a contest of arena combat. It is one of the special strikes known to a single warrior and is unleashed as a signature move.

rites.name: Vantes
rites.text: A bold, charged combined technique that a fighter can unleash in a struggle. It belongs to a masked brawler's arsenal of finishing moves.

rites.name: Teliarernum
rites.text: A coined maneuver of a band of disciplined fighters, drawn as a sudden trick of motion. It was first shown in a recent contest of skill and is performed as a special strike.

rites.name: Teliles
rites.text: A swift technique that lets a fighter surge forward in a burst of speed. It is a modified version of an older rushing maneuver once used by several earlier warriors.

rites.name: Tallaures
rites.text: A downward heel strike fighters use as a special technique, reappearing across later editions of the combat arts. It can be learned by certain warriors as a signature finishing move.

rites.name: Lianernia
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter pulls a foe close and drives a skull strike into them. It is taught as a throw, and in a later revision it was given a new label.

rites.name: Ciastus
rites.text: A trio of powerful spinning leg strikes favored by a skilled brawler. Other fighters, including a feral doppelganger and a machine-man, also employ this technique.

rites.name: Nalaurnum
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike, a rising kick delivered after a stepping motion. It first appeared in a later battle tradition and was later given a new name.

rites.name: Losenia
rites.text: A signature combination technique that a fighter aims at chosen opponents. It is recognized as a newer addition to a fighting art.

rites.name: Sosum
rites.text: A reversal technique that lets a fighter turn an opponent's attack back on them. It is a signature maneuver of a certain combatant in a tournament of martial arts.

rites.name: Seollanum
rites.text: A showy gesture performed in a duel that a fighter uses as a special technique. It is one of a warrior's signature power moves in the arena.

rites.name: Leontanum
rites.text: A bounding technique first seen in an old combat cycle, later reserved for a pair of chosen fighters. It lets a combatant leap higher than ordinary movement allows.

rites.name: Telernum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent and forces them down with a sudden, crushing twist. In later iterations it is performed as a rear throw, swapping out an older hold.

rites.name: Noniastes
rites.text: A fighter's first empowered technique, a surging forward assault unlocked through an inner gathering of power. It marks the initial stage of a warrior's heightened combat state.

rites.name: Valontia
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a brawler who lifts an opponent and slams them down. It is a signature move introduced in a recent combat contest.

rites.name: Sontor
rites.text: A piercing inner surge that a fighter unleashes once, sending their gaze wide and hair bristling upward. It marks a second stage of raw power awakened within the wielder.

rites.name: Tonaranum
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded by a skilled fighter, unleashed as a rapid flurry of kicks. It is often chosen as the ultimate move in clashes between warriors from different realms.

rites.name: Neosaulium
rites.text: A playful technique that a fighter uses to reverse their own momentum mid-combat. It is introduced as part of a newer combat system.

rites.name: Lalum
rites.text: A timed leap that lands a fighter just beyond the reach of a counter-strike. The move keeps the attacker safe from being answered by a rising reversal technique.

rites.name: Amarnor
rites.text: A airborne grappling technique in which a fighter lifts an opponent into the sky and strikes them while descending. It is used by a sorceress-like duelist in a martial arts tournament.

rites.name: Orelanum
rites.text: A timed technique lets a fighter snap one special strike straight into another with a well-judged press. A brief bright flash marks a successful link, though the same strike can never chain into itself.

rites.name: Telaunor
rites.text: A combined strike technique that pairs an open-handed blow with a sweeping cut. It belongs to one fighter's signature repertoire and was added to the arts of a modern combat tournament.

rites.name: Valasinor
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by one fighter in a modern duel contest. It is a striking maneuver unique to that fighter's combat style.

rites.name: Miantor
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique that a fighter unleashes in a contest of combat. It is one of the strongest special strikes available in the arena.

rites.name: Telaunosium
rites.text: A special technique that one fighter alone can perform, available only within a particular advanced competition mode. It is one of several moves set apart from the rest of the fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Ceosantia
rites.text: A bird-like aerial strike technique that a combatant unleashes as part of a chained finishing sequence. It belongs to a group of forceful signature maneuvers.

rites.name: Roria
rites.text: A close-range striking technique performed by a brawler from a rival lineage. It is one of his signature moves and is used to hit opponents quickly in combat.

rites.name: Telaurnia
rites.text: A precise, focused blow that a skilled fighter can unleash only under a specific, heightened training regime. It belongs to one particular combat discipline and is available only in that advanced state.

rites.name: Mauntes
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique in which the combatant drives a knee downward onto a fallen opponent. It belongs to one particular brawler's unique repertoire of moves.

rites.name: Raustium
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that is unleashed as a special strike. It was introduced in a later contest of arms and belongs to one warrior's arsenal.

rites.name: Valirnium
rites.text: A swift, fluid kick technique used by a duelist in close quarters. It began as a nameless strike in an earlier era before being refined into its present form.

rites.name: Teliarium
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique unleashed by a fierce warrior in a rapid sequence of blows. It is the first such strike that this fighter learned to perform.

rites.name: Valontiasia
rites.text: A savage technique of a masked duelist who unleashes a heavy strike from the second tier of their arsenal. It can also be joined in a shared assault alongside an ally from another fighting tradition.

rites.name: Ciasor
rites.text: A tactical maneuver used by a combatant in a contest of martial prowess. It is one of the signature special techniques available to a certain fighter in the modern arena.

rites.name: Sintium
rites.text: A fast-moving technique of a shadowed fighter who unleashes a sweeping wave of force. It is a newer move added to a cruel warrior's repertoire in a special competitive mode.

rites.name: Sistallum
rites.text: A fighter's ultimate technique, a relentless flurry of stretching limbs and fiery breath unleashed at the peak of their power. It is the most devastating finishing move in the arsenal of a single master.

rites.name: Naullonum
rites.text: A ferocious skull-shaped energy technique that a fighter unleashes as a finishing combo. It belongs to a wild, mask-loving battle style.

rites.name: Amiastantum
rites.text: A timed sequence of moves that a fighter links together to hit an opponent. It is one of the signature targeted routines belonging to a certain brawler.

rites.name: Meoraulor
rites.text: A devastating chained strike wielded by a fierce warrior, unleashed in a rapid sequence of blows that ends in a crushing finishing hit. It first appears in the third installment of a famous battle-fighting saga.

rites.name: Seonum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver that a fighter uses to hurl an opponent during close combat. It is one of the close-range throws available to a particular brawler.

rites.name: Serialor
rites.text: A tumbling evasion technique in which a fighter rolls across the ground to escape danger. It can be used forward or to recover after being knocked down.

rites.name: Valirneonor
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that first appears in a later training tome, then returns as a reversal maneuver in a newer scroll of combat. It is used as a special attack by a single named warrior.

rites.name: Orostia
rites.text: A signature striking technique used by a fierce wandering duelist, drawn from the flow of a heated rival. It delivers a sudden, rapid kick that catches opponents off guard.

rites.name: Saurnirus
rites.text: A special technique wielded by a fighter in a competitive arena. It is introduced as part of a shared tournament between two rival martial traditions.

rites.name: Reontor
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by one fighter in a tournament of combat arts. It is a special strike that a practitioner unleashes in a moment of focus, first revealed in a later chapter of the contest.

rites.name: Serentiria
rites.text: A stylized martial discipline performed in a modern fighting arena, practiced as one of a fighter's signature ultimate techniques. It is newly introduced and belongs to a single trained practitioner's repertoire.

rites.name: Seosauntia
rites.text: A distinctive technique that a fighter can unleash in close combat. It was introduced in a recent contest of the arena era and belongs to one particular warrior's repertoire.

rites.name: Mallausia
rites.text: A signature technique of a warrior who draws on a cultivated inner stillness. It is performed in combat as a single, practiced maneuver.

rites.name: Corelum
rites.text: A fighting technique where a combatant hurls an opponent with a sudden kick. It is used as a signature move by one brawler in a clash of rival warrior factions.

rites.name: Niasus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent from behind and hurls them to the ground. It belongs to the repertoire of a certain brawler's close-range maneuvers.

rites.name: Orausum
rites.text: A distinctive fighting technique belonging to one of the combatants, newly introduced in the most recent contest of arms. It is one of this fighter's signature movements.

rites.name: Tinum
rites.text: A quick, twittering strike performed by a nimble trickster-fighter. It was taught to practitioners in a later era of a fighting school's training.

rites.name: Veollum
rites.text: A quick strike used by a fighter in arena duels, it is a light-based throw that answers an opponent's careless openings. It first appeared in a sparring tournament of rival schools.

rites.name: Saleostor
rites.text: A tactical maneuver used by a fighter who leaps upward to seize an airborne foe and drive them down. It is one of the signature finishing techniques of a hulking brawler.

rites.name: Lernum
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a fighter spins the body and sweeps a foot through the air to strike an opponent. It is one of the throwing techniques used by a particular brawler in a modern arena contest.

rites.name: Naseornum
rites.text: A chilling technique used by a fighter of the northern dojo, delivering a quick attack that leaves a sharp cold sting behind.

rites.name: Larnia
rites.text: A forceful strike technique used by a seasoned brawler in a rival combat tradition. It first appeared as a special move in an earlier tournament of fighting champions.

rites.name: Narneres
rites.text: A fighter's first awakened power, a surge of inner force that a warrior unlocks early in their training. It marks the moment a combatant begins to command a new fighting style.

rites.name: Ninus
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a brawler seizes an opponent and hurls them with crushing force. It is one of the special moves of a hulking wrestler.

rites.name: Ceolus
rites.text: A fighter's unique technique that is introduced in a recent combat contest. It belongs to one specific combatant and is a special strike within that person's repertoire.

rites.name: Leones
rites.text: A signature striking technique wielded by a single named fighter in a modern combat contest. It is one of that combatant's distinctive attacks, introduced in a recent tournament-style clash of skill.

rites.name: Orialor
rites.text: A signature striking technique wielded by one fighter in a modern duel-based sport. It is a unique move that has recently been added to the fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Sestinor
rites.text: A dark finishing technique wielded by a fearsome fighter, unlocked only through mastery of his strongest combat skill. It is the ultimate strike in a clash of rival champions.

rites.name: Reontaustia
rites.text: A signature technique a fighter can unleash only while in a heightened, empowered stance. It is a ki-charged parry-and-sweep maneuver.

rites.name: Teontanum
rites.text: A devastating technique that a sorceress unleashes in a single burst. In a later stage of its development it becomes her second ability of this sort.

rites.name: Venor
rites.text: A devastating ritual technique performed by a monk-like fighter, unleashing a rising eruption of flame. It has reappeared in later contests as an alternate form of the same forceful art.

rites.name: Ciallus
rites.text: A grappling technique practiced by one fighter in a contest of close combat. It is a throw that lifts an opponent's leg to bring them down.

rites.name: Rorellia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter, available only in a heightened combat state within a modern arena contest. It is one of that fighter's special strikes.

rites.name: Serantaunes
rites.text: A fighter's forceful knee strike, performed in a fierce upward thrust. It is one of the signature special moves of a towering battler and has been refined across several combat tournaments.

rites.name: Teleres
rites.text: A dormant inner force that a fighter draws forth into a brief, heightened state of combat mastery. It is one of the strongest ultimate techniques a warrior can unleash in a duel.

rites.name: Mosanum
rites.text: A brawler's signature flurry of rapid, hammering blows unleashed by one particular fighter. It is a newer technique within a fighting style, first appearing in a recent tournament-era contest.

rites.name: Vauror
rites.text: A devastating technique that channels a falling celestial body through the fighter's strike. It is one of the ultimate forms of power unlocked in a later combat tradition.

rites.name: Leornus
rites.text: A tactic where a fighter in a paired team cuts short an attack and hands control to their partner mid-sequence. The handoff lets the chain of blows continue and grow longer.

rites.name: Neolirum
rites.text: A jolting forward strike performed by a lone fighter, unique to one practitioner's repertoire. It was introduced in a later contest of arms.

rites.name: Sintus
rites.text: A fighter's signature maneuver that leaps through the air at an angle, striking an opponent in mid-motion. It is one of the special techniques used by a young practitioner of the craft.

rites.name: Coristanum
rites.text: A signature technique of a single wandering fighter, first gained as her opening superior art in one lineage of contests and later as her ultimate blow in another. It is a spinning strike that a trained combatant unleashes at full power.

rites.name: Niasillum
rites.text: A unique technique of a fighter who channels a surge of hostile force into a single decisive blow. It was devised recently and belongs to a particular practitioner's repertoire.

rites.name: Sosantium
rites.text: A unique technique used by a pair of opposed combatants, introduced in a later chapter of their rivalry. It is one of the signature moves that belongs to them alone.

rites.name: Telirium
rites.text: A ranged technique that a practitioner performs as a special strike. It belongs to the arsenal of a single combatant in an arena fighting tradition.

rites.name: Siallornus
rites.text: A swinging rising punch that a fighter delivers while standing, first used as a heavy blow and later reworked into a signature technique. Its name changed in a later version of the training manual.

rites.name: Viasaullum
rites.text: A three-part sequence of strikes that a fighter can chain together in a set rhythm. It is one of the targeted combinations a character can draw upon in a contest of skill.

rites.name: Seriastum
rites.text: A rapid two-handed striking technique used by a single hardy fighter. It was later given a plainer name by the teachers who passed it on.

rites.name: Vernaurum
rites.text: A distinctive striking technique belonging to a single fighter, first shown in a recent combat tournament. It is one of that fighter's signature moves.

rites.name: Callaunia
rites.text: A fighter's neutral strike that hurls a flaring shard of sunlight forward. It serves as a basic ranged blow in combat.

rites.name: Lintes
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by a fighter who presses an attack with the aim of shattering an opponent's guard. It was devised for a late modern contest of combat arts.

rites.name: Nialesia
rites.text: A fighter seizes an opponent mid-air with a slick, oiled hold that drags them down. It is a follow-up strike that comes after a grab-based attack.

rites.name: Rarum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that reverses an opponent's drive, granting the user a sudden counter-motion in combat. It is a modern tactic learned by a brawler's guild.

rites.name: Maulium
rites.text: A chained sequence of blows that follows a successful lifting strike and lets the attacker swap to another fighter mid-combo. It belongs to the craft of aerial assault and tag-team fighting.

rites.name: Serelia
rites.text: A distinctive strike technique unique to one fighter's repertoire, first appearing in a recent clash of arts. It belongs to a single practitioner's signature style.

rites.name: Naulanum
rites.text: A swift, fiery technique wielded by a brawler, first recorded in an early tournament chronicle and later adopted in a wider arena of duelists.

rites.name: Casiarnium
rites.text: A coordinated pair of strikes that a fighter aims at an opponent. It is one of the sequences a practitioner trains to chain together in a modern combat art.

rites.name: Vorestanum
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike, a rising claw-like swipe unique to one warrior. It was introduced into the fighting arts in a recent age of contests.

rites.name: Saranum
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that chains several heavy sweeping strikes together. It is one of the exclusive moves that belongs to a single combatant in the modern arena.

rites.name: Nalistium
rites.text: A fierce radiant technique wielded by a savage warrior in a combat tournament. It unleashes a blazing burst of luminous energy against foes.

rites.name: Vanentium
rites.text: A signature technique of a combat style that a fighter unleashes in a rhythmic burst. It belongs to the super moves that a warrior can call upon when the fight reaches its peak.

rites.name: Ceosirnia
rites.text: A special technique wielded by a lone fighter, introduced alongside them in a later installment of a long-running combat saga. It is a punching attack that can strike opponents overhead.

rites.name: Seolor
rites.text: A leaping forward punch used by two fighters in a fighting contest. It has been dropped and later restored in a weaker form.

rites.name: Ciallornia
rites.text: A swift, unusual strike belonging to one fighter's personal arsenal. It exists only in the fighter's own style and appears in a newer tournament-era battle system.

rites.name: Amostialium
rites.text: A fourth staged sequence of blows that a fighter performs in a set order to strike a chosen target. It belongs to the combat art practiced by a single swift acrobat within a larger contest of martial skill.

rites.name: Tiarnus
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a nimble fighter, executed as a special strike. It was introduced in a later contest of arms.

rites.name: Niasanum
rites.text: A special maneuver used by a fighter in a combat tournament, unleashed as a signature attack. It was newly added to the fighter's repertoire in a recent contest of skill.

rites.name: Raullia
rites.text: A stalking battle posture used by one fighter in their unique combat repertoire. It lets the user creep low and strike unexpectedly.

rites.name: Amiaranium
rites.text: A clash where two combatants land blows on each other in the same instant. Neither side gains the upper hand, and both must recover.

rites.name: Corenontia
rites.text: A reversing maneuver that a fighter performs to turn an opponent's assault back against them. It is wielded as a defensive counter within a modern combat tradition.

rites.name: Mauseolor
rites.text: A swift technique used in a combat discipline, where the practitioner strikes with a rapid, layered motion. It is a signature move of a rogue clan of fighters.

rites.name: Amornium
rites.text: A bitter whirlwind of frozen force that a fighter can unleash from their body to strike a foe. It is a signature technique of a wrestler known for brute power, and it appeared in the most recent sweep of duels.

rites.name: Telisiarnia
rites.text: A mock-heavy strike technique that copies the signature blast of a rival fighter's style. It works as a comic imitation of a more famous technique.

rites.name: Telauntosia
rites.text: A set of powerful signature maneuvers that any combatant can unleash by entering a precise sequence of directional inputs and button presses. Skilled duelists consider mastering them essential to evening the contest against experts.

rites.name: Cintium
rites.text: A rapid-fire kneeling strike used in combat by a warrior of the wider order. It is one of the fighter's signature repeated blows.

rites.name: Telaseornes
rites.text: A fighter's rapid, lashing kick technique that strikes upward at airborne foes. Practitioners nickname it a flurry of wings, and it can be empowered for greater force.

rites.name: Raullia Nauror
rites.text: A devastating ritual technique drawn from a warrior's disciplined arts, unleashed as a dramatic display of overwhelming power. It belongs to the greatest class of combat maneuvers a fighter can master.

rites.name: Telisum
rites.text: A grappling throw practiced by fighters of the mirrored arena, where a combatant lifts an opponent and hurls them into the air. It is one of several throws favored by a single veteran brawler.

rites.name: Vilum
rites.text: A ritual maneuver in which a wielder hurls a fearsome bone-masked figure's technique in a sudden burst. It is a signature art among the masked fighters of the arena circuit.

rites.name: Coralum
rites.text: A hurling technique practiced by a martial brawler, in which the fighter flings an opponent with a broad sweeping motion. It is taught as a standard move among the warriors of the bathhouse-keeping sect.

rites.name: Serauria
rites.text: A special technique wielded by a fearsome battle-master, unleashed in a rapid display of combat prowess. It appeared in a later revision of a famous contest of fighters.

rites.name: Reollor
rites.text: A volatile inner-fire technique that a fighter awakens after their first surge of a sealed power, transforming their ultimate strike into a shifting, unpredictable form.

rites.name: Amistonium
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter, spun up as a whirling assault. It is known casually by a nickname that refers to its shape.

rites.name: Neolles
rites.text: A tactic where a fighter lands a quick strike that leaves the foe pressed into defense, then follows with a grab that catches them open. It relies on timing and quick recovery.

rites.name: Ralonum
rites.text: A charged strike used by a fighter of the dark streets, delivered with the heel and releasing a jolt of energy. It was introduced in a later round of combat.

rites.name: Amirnasus
rites.text: A fighter's strike that resembles a spinning kick and can be chained into a second blow. It exists in a home-console contest of combat.

rites.name: Reraustium
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded by a skilled fighter in a tournament-style arena. It returns in a later trial mode as an enhanced variant of a related combat maneuver.

rites.name: Telestum
rites.text: A reversal technique used by a skilled combatant to turn an opponent's pressure back against them. It is a defensive counter-move tied to a specific fighter's style.

rites.name: Naureollium
