rites.text: A devastating technique wielded by a fearsome fighter in a clash between rival fighting traditions. It is performed as a special move in a combat contest.

rites.name: Telentium
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by a fighter in a combat contest. It is one of a kind and is practiced by a single martial duelist.

rites.name: Niasteollum
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by a fighter in a combat contest, unleashed as one of its special attacks. It belongs to the newest set of combat techniques introduced to the arena.

rites.name: Serilia
rites.text: A devastating ultimate strike, passed down from an older fighting discipline, that a fearsome wandering brawler unleashes as his signature. A few rivals who have studied the same dark arts can also call it forth.

rites.name: Vares
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a masked duelist while airborne, seizing a foe midair and hurling them down. It reappears across later iterations of the art under an altered designation.

rites.name: Leontirum
rites.text: A dark variant of a fiery strike, most often linked with a brooding warrior. Several other fighters can call upon it during crossover encounters.

rites.name: Oraullor
rites.text: A close-quarters technique used by a dark wrestler to launch a forward strike. It is performed whether the fighter moves toward an opponent or stands still.

rites.name: Rillium
rites.text: A corrupted clawing technique that a fighter can perform as one of their signature super moves. It belongs to a practitioner who wields it in combat.

rites.name: Cesor
rites.text: A decisive closing blow thrown by a fighter who has reached the right moment. It is one of the throws in the arsenal of a warrior from a modern martial tradition.

rites.name: Sereontum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter lifts an opponent by the face and hurls them aside. It is a special maneuver practiced by a masked duelist of the arenas.

rites.name: Coresium
rites.text: A sudden shifting technique that a fighter unleashes to break through an opponent's guard. It is introduced as part of a later enhanced version of the duel-combat system.

rites.name: Valaulia
rites.text: A devastating ultimate technique wielded by a fighter in a combat contest. It is unleashed by spending a full stock of accumulated power, and it can end a bout in a single decisive strike.

rites.name: Mollia
rites.text: A close-range striking technique used by a seasoned brawler, delivered with the forearm and point of the elbow. It belongs to the fighter's personal repertoire and was first introduced in a modern tournament circuit.

rites.name: Ameria
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded by a fighter who channels a stored inner force into a single crushing blow. It is unleashed in the closing moments of a bout.

rites.name: Telaria
rites.text: A spinning sweeping technique practiced by a brawler, first recorded in an early arena contest and later revived in a newer tournament. It is one of the fighter's signature maneuvers.

rites.name: Vernia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single combatant, learned in a recent tournament-era clash. It is one of the fighter's distinctive moves, set apart from the common techniques shared by others.

rites.name: Sereonornus
rites.text: A special leaping technique belonging to one fighter, drawn from a dancer's rhythm. It was added in a later contest of skill and is performed in combat.

rites.name: Caliarnor
rites.text: A fighter's combat technique that splits their own power into a sudden burst of attacks. It is a special break move of the V-Shift style, freely usable by the one who knows it.

rites.name: Amollanum
rites.text: A universal technique that lifts an opponent off the ground during play. It is performed with a strong button combination and can be used by any fighter.

rites.name: Ciliantium
rites.text: A bond-craft is a special technique wielded by one fighter in a combat arena. It is one of the signature moves of a single named duelist, first recorded in a modern tournament age.

rites.name: Larnus
rites.text: A grappling maneuver in which a fighter seizes a foe's arm and pries it sideways to upend their guard. It is one of several close-quarters throws used in brawling contests.

rites.name: Mintor
rites.text: A signature strike unique to one fighter, first introduced in a modern combat contest. It is one of the special techniques that set this combatant apart from the rest.

rites.name: Ceornilus
rites.text: A surge of power that a fighter unleashes in the first of their two heightened battle states. It serves as the opening stage of a wielder's gathered might.

rites.name: Amanes
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a combatant cancel an opponent's ongoing assault by releasing a sudden surge of energy. It is granted to a fighter who has been trained in a particular rhythmic form of combat.

rites.name: Lostarnus
rites.text: A violent crackling tempest of charged energy is unleashed by a combatant in a contest of arms. It stands as the first of their ultimate, devastating techniques.

rites.name: Tentus
rites.text: A flashy maneuver practiced by a fighter of the arena. It is one of the fighter's signature special moves, newly taught to the warriors of the ring.

rites.name: Miallus
rites.text: A practiced wielder unleashes a sudden, devastating flurry of strikes, the most forceful of their fighting arts. It is the first such technique a fighter learns to master.

rites.name: Rornilium
rites.text: A fighter's distinctive striking technique that belongs to one combatant. It was introduced in a later contest of skill, marking it as a newer craft among the arts of the ring.

rites.name: Tillia
rites.text: A devastating technique wielded by a fighter in arena combat, known for dazzling strikes. It was once replaced by another move before returning to the fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Rantor
rites.text: A short-ranged throw technique that a young fighter uses in a modern combat tournament. It lets the user grapple an opponent and hurl them to the ground.

rites.name: Lianor
rites.text: A powerful signature technique that a fighter can unleash only once a special condition is met. It strings together many rapid strikes, hitting the foe repeatedly in a single flurry.

rites.name: Telianises
rites.text: A timed sequence of strikes that a fighter can chain together in a particular order. It is introduced as one of the moves a certain combat specialist can perform.

rites.name: Vaullum
rites.text: A fierce special technique used by a wielder of spinning blades. It is an empowered version of a more basic circular strike and is unlocked in a high-difficulty trial mode.

rites.name: Caullus
rites.text: A signature combat maneuver performed by a wrestler in a sporting arena. It can be executed in two different fighting styles and comes in several variations.

rites.name: Veosales
rites.text: A coiled finishing technique that a fighter unleashes in a sudden rush of air to strike the opponent. It is one of the special moves of a particular combatant in a tournament-style contest.

rites.name: Orosarus
rites.text: A fighter's rising strike, a signature technique in which the combatant launches upward with a fierce, sweeping blow. It belongs solely to one warrior and marks the newest style of their combat school.

rites.name: Teliastus
rites.text: A furious lance-thrust technique wielded by a fighter in a combat arena, unleashed at the lowest tier of a gathered power meter. It is the first of the fighter's stored ultimate strikes.

rites.name: Corialum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a young fighter, first introduced in a competitive combat tournament setting. It is one of the distinctive strikes unique to that youthful practitioner.

rites.name: Teollesanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that a fighter can unleash as a powerful finishing combo. It was devised for a rival's style of combat.

rites.name: Serantus
rites.text: A fighter may interrupt a running strike by launching a stronger technique from its recovery, chaining moves into one fluid flurry. The method has since spread to many rival combat contests.

rites.name: Valoria
rites.text: A close-range striking technique that a fighter uses to hit an opponent's face. It belongs to one fighter's personal repertoire and was added in a recent contest of skill.

rites.name: Rarneonia
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a masked combatant hurls their face covering at an opponent. It is one of the special moves that such a warrior can perform in staged contests.

rites.name: Corasor
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike that drains an opponent's strength through a deadly, enticing gesture. It can be unleashed as a major technique in combat and later as a powerful finishing move.

rites.name: Amoria
rites.text: A technique used in a modern combat contest, where a fighter performs a throw. It is one of the moves belonging to a particular fighter introduced in a recent tournament.

rites.name: Cirniaria
rites.text: A fighter's rehearsed aerial strike that rises from a crouch and descends on an opponent. It returns later as a defensive counter that reverses an enemy's pressure.

rites.name: Naullum
rites.text: A fierce bodily technique used by a warrior, first taught in a later training lineage. It appears again and again in many later contests and can also be borrowed by others in altered forms.

rites.name: Teleorialum
rites.text: A showy closing gambit that a skilled fighter may unleash to end a clash with flair. It proved harder to pull off in later contests, yet remains achievable.

rites.name: Siastium
rites.text: A reversal technique in which a fighter turns an opponent's rushing drive attack back against them. It belongs to a warrior's signature repertoire of counter-moves.

rites.name: Narnus
rites.text: A charged technique that a fighter releases as a fast, forceful wave of air pressure aimed straight ahead. A rival copies it, and a sharper, power-infused version exists as well.

rites.name: Coreostor
rites.text: A neutral attack used in combat by a fighter across two arena brawls. It is a throw that grabs an opponent and hurls them away.

rites.name: Coreolia
rites.text: A powerful signature technique performed by a brawler in a combat tournament. It is unlocked as a devastating finishing move in a crossover fighting clash.

rites.name: Ceolanum
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique, one of the special moves a warrior can unleash in a brawling contest between rival champions.

rites.name: Corianium
rites.text: A grappling throw performed by a fighter in a combat tournament, in which the fighter spins an opponent overhead and hurls them to the ground.

rites.name: Masaunum
rites.text: A signature combined maneuver that a fighter unleashes in a clash of arms. It is reserved for one particular combatant and exists only in one brawling contest.

rites.name: Vaunia
rites.text: A fighter's special technique delivered as a kick from mid-air, striking downward onto an opponent. It can be empowered for a stronger version.

rites.name: Corausteles
rites.text: A special technique that a fighter can perform only while in a heightened, altered combat state. It is a stance-based maneuver tied to that state.

rites.name: Serarnialia
rites.text: A signature technique of one fighter, unleashed as a special strike in combat. It is one of that warrior's unique attacks.

rites.name: Serornia
rites.text: A devastating combined strike unleashed by two allied fighters together. It belongs to a set of powerful finishing techniques used in a long tournament-combat tradition.

rites.name: Tistialum
rites.text: A nimble technique in which a fighter strikes a foe through a rapid sequence set up by a specific attack. It is one of the signature linked strikes a warrior can chain after a successful opening blow.

rites.name: Sianeles
rites.text: A solitary combat discipline practiced by a single fighter who invented it. Its sole practitioner uses it as his own personal method of unarmed battle.

rites.name: Lentor
rites.text: A signature spinning technique that a fighter unleashes as a powerful finishing burst. Several rival warriors also learn to use it, and it has appeared in later combat trials.

rites.name: Miastanium
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter, first gained as a second ultimate art. A rival in an earlier stage of the tradition could also learn it, but later lost the ability to perform it.

rites.name: Nirnaullor
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded by a fierce brawler, unleashed as an enhanced ultimate strike. It later returns as that same fighter's powerful special attack in a rival arena.

rites.name: Nesonus
rites.text: A chosen power of a fierce wild warrior, unleashed as a special surge of energy. It is the first such awakening that this fighter learns in the arena.

rites.name: Cesium
rites.text: A devastating ultimate technique wielded by a fearsome warrior. It is a powerful special move that unleashes overwhelming force upon an opponent in a duel.

rites.name: Neonilium
rites.text: A signature strike unleashed by a fighter in a heightened combat mode. It delivers a gust-driven kick that only this special state can perform.

rites.name: Teraullum
rites.text: A fighter's most forceful ultimate strike, a stronger form of their earlier charging rush. It belongs to a brawler's set of powerful finishing moves.

rites.name: Telonia
rites.text: A signature aerial maneuver used by a sky-fighting warrior. It is one of the special strikes that marks this fighter's unique style of combat.

rites.name: Nornia
rites.text: A grappling technique that a fighter uses to hurl an opponent to the ground. It has appeared in later combat contests and is known for its use by a single practitioner.

rites.name: Meontia
rites.text: A devastating technique that a fighter unleashes, appearing in a standard form and a charged variant. It is one of the signature ultimate moves of a particular combatant.

rites.name: Leosalia
rites.text: A heavy forward punch used by a fighter who strikes with brutal force. It was first added to the roster of attacks and later became a special move for a rival warrior.

rites.name: Viantes
rites.text: A fighter's finishing technique that wrenches an opponent's body in a spiraling motion. It is one of the special strikes available to a brawler in a modern combat arena.

rites.name: Veoreles
rites.text: A learned striking technique borrowed by imitation from a master of a rival school. It is also performed by a darker, altered version of its practitioner.

rites.name: Serontum
rites.text: A swift discipline of leaping and vaulting through urban spaces, practiced as a martial art. Its followers train to move past obstacles with fluid, acrobatic motion.

rites.name: Raunolus
rites.text: A stylized technique of a fighting art that a combatant unleashes with heavy force. It is one of the signature moves unique to a particular fighter.

rites.name: Corillentor
rites.text: A grappling move used by a hooded brawler in a rival arena tournament. It lets the fighter hurl an opponent backward in a sudden, awkward sweep.

rites.name: Masor
rites.text: A reversing maneuver that a fighter performs to change their facing and direction while holding the initiative. It was added in a recent contest of skirmishers and has since been seen in later bouts.

rites.name: Seraulium
rites.text: A signature maneuver of a fighter in a modern combat tournament, this technique launches the user skyward from an opponent's position. It is considered one of the character's unique attacks.

rites.name: Corelanum
rites.text: A grappling technique where a fighter seizes an opponent and hurls them over the shoulder from behind. It belongs to one brawler's repertoire in a modern combat tournament.

rites.name: Tiases
rites.text: A chained sequence of strikes that a fighter aims at a particular opponent. It is one of the preferred combinations of a skilled warrior and was devised for the current era of rivalries.

rites.name: Nariarnium
rites.text: A signature maneuver belonging to a young fighter, unlocked for the modern arena contests. It is performed as a single unique strike within the combat roster.

rites.name: Oroses
rites.text: A signature maneuver a fighter performs in close combat, unlocked and refined over many matches. It is one of the special strikes unique to a single combatant.

rites.name: Liareostus
rites.text: A grappling discipline passed between a young fighter and her elder relative, taught as a close-combat craft. It draws on a distant foreign ground-wrestling tradition.

rites.name: Orialostum
rites.text: A powerful signature maneuver that a fighter can unleash only within one particular arcade contest. Unlike ordinary combinations, it is triggered by pressing the dedicated strike key.

rites.name: Rostiles
rites.text: A dormant inner flame that a warrior awakens to unleash a sudden burst of power. It is the first of several such surges mastered by a shapeshifting duelist.

rites.name: Veollor
rites.text: A signature striking sequence belonging to a fighter in a modern arena contest. It is a special move that the combatant can perform in a fight.

rites.name: Serantes
rites.text: A glowing sphere of inner spirit that one fighter unleashes in a special ultimate form of combat. It is available only in that enhanced, elevated state of the duel.

rites.name: Laurnum
rites.text: A close-range grappling technique used by a fighter who clamps an opponent's midsection. It is a neutral throw, performed without any directional input.

rites.name: Valistaunia
rites.text: A signature striking technique used by a fighter in a combat arena. It is a unique knee attack that the fighter can deliver in close quarters.

rites.name: Valaunanum
rites.text: A swift counterstrike thrown the instant a combatant is struck, turning a defensive moment into a sudden answer. Fighters use it to seize the initiative back from an opponent.

rites.name: Valernores
rites.text: A quick leg-based technique belonging to one fighter of a warrior circle. It is performed in combat and was added to that fighter's repertoire in a later age of the Library.

rites.name: Naullia
rites.text: A flaw in an old arcade combat machine lets one warrior slide upward across the display. Two particular duelists can trigger it.

rites.name: Cirnium
rites.text: A bruising kick technique practiced by a cheerful brawler, which replaces an older strike from a previous training manual. It is a special move that crushes the opponent's guard.

rites.name: Nallosor
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike that the combatant can unleash with a striking blow of unusual power. It belongs only to one practitioner and appears in the newest generation of contests.

rites.name: Tolum
rites.text: A practiced sequence of strikes that a fighter learns to chain together. It is one of the targeted combinations of a skilled duelist's repertoire.

rites.name: Valania
rites.text: A coordinated set of blows that a skilled combatant can unleash in a timed sequence. It is available to one fighter in certain tournament-style duels.

rites.name: Roles Vaurellor
rites.text: A ritual strike wielded by a fighter named Rose, drawn from the lore of a combat tradition. It is one of her special techniques and was introduced in a recent contest of skill.

rites.name: Varnanum
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by a fighter, introduced in a recent combat contest. It belongs to a single warrior's repertoire of special techniques.

rites.name: Valirus
rites.text: A signature technique belonging to a fighter named Dorvann, unveiled in a recent combat tournament. It is one of the fighter's distinctive moves.

rites.name: Telistornor
rites.text: A grander kind of strike that is an advanced form of a power attack, meant to close out a battle as a final blow. It serves as a finisher more fully than ordinary power strikes do.

rites.name: Corallanum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single fighter in an arena-combat contest. It can only be performed in a special high-intensity competition mode.

rites.name: Launia Larium
rites.text: A signature maneuver belonging to a single fighter, unveiled in a modern combat contest. It grips an opponent with a mystical pull drawn from the wielder's inner essence.

rites.name: Sereolor
rites.text: A reversing maneuver practiced by a sky-warrior that turns a fall into a counterstrike. It is used by a brawling fighter of the duelist class.

rites.name: Serenus
rites.text: A fighter's aerial throwing technique that seizes an opponent mid-leap. It is practiced by a stocky grappler from a mountain circuit.

rites.name: Tanium
rites.text: A tuned sonic wave is hurled forward in a rapid barrage. Several wielders can channel the same resonant force through their own gear.

rites.name: Ronteornium
rites.text: A quick combat maneuver in which a fighter reads a foe's motion and triggers a prepared sequence at the right moment. It rewards precise timing and the anticipation of an opponent's next move.

rites.name: Amaustum
rites.text: A quick leaping maneuver performed by one fighter in a contest of close combat. It is one of the moves that fighter can use to strike an opponent.

rites.name: Rontia
rites.text: A grappling-style hurl used by a wandering fighter, performed by yanking a cord-like line to fling the body forward. It was added to the fighter's repertoire in a recent martial tournament.

rites.name: Taustus
rites.text: A signature strike used by a combatant in a modern arena. It is one of the unique attacks belonging to a particular fighter and appears in a recent contest of martial skill.

rites.name: Relium
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by two fighters in a modern combat tournament. It counts as a special strike unique to each of them.

rites.name: Corisoles
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded by a warrior across many appearances, first seen in a comic-style brawler. It is also taught to a rival fighter and to a mechanical copy of the same warrior.

rites.name: Taunum
rites.text: A signature technique unique to one fighter, used in a close-quarters duel. It is one of the distinctive moves that marks a particular combatant's style.

rites.name: Miasor
rites.text: A recovery technique in which a struck figure is lifted from a tumbling, airborne state and set back onto their feet. It returns a fallen combatant to a standing position mid-battle.

rites.name: Valilus
rites.text: A whirling technique used by a fighter in close combat, spinning the body in a wide circle to strike at nearby foes. It belongs to a single character's repertoire of special moves.

rites.name: Neoriantus
rites.text: A tactic in which an attacker builds a situation that restarts the damage counting from zero. It is often used to confuse the defender about where they will land and which way to block.

rites.name: Telanum
rites.text: A heavy foot-driven maneuver used by a towering grappler in a combat arena. It was first a special technique in an advanced mode and later returned as a unique attack.

rites.name: Rasestor
rites.text: A high-tier ritual combat technique that a trained performer unleashes at a set charge level. It is distinct from the performer's other powerful moves.

rites.name: Corenaulium
rites.text: A close-range blow aimed low that a fighter throws to keep an opponent off balance. It is one of the signature techniques unique to a single combatant.

rites.name: Mintus
rites.text: A signature strike performed by a nimble, mischievous fighter, unique to that one combatant. It first appears in a later tournament-style chronicle of the duels.

rites.name: Soniallanum
rites.text: A signature rising strike performed by a wandering brawler, later learned by two other fighters. It is an attack that launches an opponent into the air.

rites.name: Merales
rites.text: A fighter's ultimate upward kick technique that launches an opponent into the air. It is a powerful, empowered rising strike used as a second finishing art.

rites.name: Seralaurum
rites.text: A signature rising blow used by a fighter in a tournament brawl. It launches opponents upward with a sudden burst of force.

rites.name: Orauntia
rites.text: A reversed counter-strike technique in which a fighter turns an incoming blow into a fierce answering attack. It belongs to the modern arena style of combat.

rites.name: Meorentes
rites.text: A signature maneuver belonging to one fighter in a modern contest of martial arts. It is performed only by that fighter and sets them apart from every other combatant.

rites.name: Veonanum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single fighter in a modern combat arena. It is a special move introduced in the newest contest of arena fighting.

rites.name: Ralirnes
rites.text: A signature forceful strike technique used by a fighter in a combat arena. It can also be chained into specific sequences that land against an opponent.

rites.name: Ristum
rites.text: A sudden reversal of a rushing strike that turns the attacker's momentum back against them. It is a tactical maneuver used in close combat contests.

rites.name: Millauntor
rites.text: A coiling strike technique practiced by a fighter who lashes out with sudden, whip-like force. It is one of the special moves known to the fighter's school.

rites.name: Ciastanum Rolleoses
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single fighter, exclusive to one crossover contest. It is a special strike performed as part of that fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Orelus
rites.text: A forceful tactical strike technique that a fighter unleashes in a rushing burst. It is drawn from the fighter's own practiced arts and relates to a modern combat style.

rites.name: Nilum
rites.text: A bright, scorching technique used by a fighter in a combat contest. It is one of the signature special moves belonging to a particular combatant.

rites.name: Liarus
rites.text: A signature technique belonging to one particular fighter, usable only when a special enhanced battle state is active. It is one of that combatant's unique moves.

rites.name: Telistes
rites.text: A signature finishing technique unleashed by a fighter using a special charged power meter. It is a boosted, ultimate attack available only in that enhanced state.

rites.name: Amollirnum
rites.text: A stronger form of a sky-leaping strike drawn from the crane discipline. It is the second such finisher learned by its practitioner, offering greater force than its predecessor.

rites.name: Orillor
rites.text: A close-range striking technique that a fighter performs with a rising blow of the fist. It is a refined version of an older standing strike, now reworked as a signature move in a modern combat art.

rites.name: Orinanum
rites.text: A violent rising strike performed by a shock-charged brawler, lifting the foe skyward with crackling force. It belongs to the signature arsenal of a single fighter.

rites.name: Telantornus
rites.text: A sudden surge of gathered force that a fighter unleashes as a powerful ultimate technique. It is an amplified form of an older, more restrained strike.

rites.name: Monerium
rites.text: A hidden grappling variation that a wrestler may perform when a foe has turned away from him. In later iterations it stands apart as its own maneuver.

rites.name: Amarnum
rites.text: A special technique unique to a hardened battle mode, practiced by a wandering martial artist. It is only available when a fighter enters that heightened combat state.

rites.name: Tiastinum
rites.text: A grounded technique of forceful momentum that a fighter delivers in a single firm motion. It is a mechanic drawn from the same wellspring as other combat-drive arts.

rites.name: Valineosia
rites.text: A low, crouching kick used by fighters to knock an opponent off their feet. Many warriors in the arena rely on this sweeping strike as a basic move.

rites.name: Lialanus
rites.text: A special technique that belongs only to one fighter in a particular competitive combat mode. It lets the user slip away from an incoming strike and leave a hollow afterimage behind.

rites.name: Seonia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter in a combat tradition. It is a special strike introduced in a recent contest of skill, belonging to one practitioner's repertoire.

rites.name: Teleonia
rites.text: A stylized burst of flash-kick movement that a fighter unleashes as a finishing attack. It serves as a signature cross-art move shared between two combatant styles.

rites.name: Mosaullanum
rites.text: A devastating fire technique wielded by a fighter in combat, unleashed as a special attack. It is a signature strike drawn from a particular fighting style.

rites.name: Mesium
rites.text: A powerful airborne technique used by a fighter in a recent combat tradition. It ranks among the practitioner's advanced finishing arts.

rites.name: Oranaullia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter in a tournament of gem combatants. It is one of the special attacks performed by its user, first appearing in a later installment of the contest.

rites.name: Veollanum
rites.text: A low, gliding strike unique to one fighter's repertoire, first seen in a later generation of arena combat. It lets the wielder slip along the ground beneath an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Laustor
rites.text: A hidden technique wielded by a combatant in a sparring arena, unleashed as a powerful second-tier strike. It is a special art belonging to one particular fighter.

rites.name: Tanum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent's midsection with a rapid, armor-piercing hold. It is one of the signature special moves of a particular duelist.

rites.name: Niles
rites.text: A soldier's trained close-quarters punch that a fighter can unleash as a special technique. It is a second-tier power drawn from a stored energy gauge.

rites.name: Visteonor
rites.text: A specialized combat technique used by the fighters of a martial order. It is a powerful maneuver that a member performs during a clash, drawn from the training of a modern arena circuit.

rites.name: Lontes
rites.text: A crackling discharge of stored energy that strikes upward at airborne foes. It is the second great technique of a sorcerer who draws power from an unseen current.

rites.name: Valeostolor
rites.text: A newly devised combat technique that lets a fighter chain two empowered strikes together in a single flowing sequence. It appeared in a later revision of an arena brawling tradition.

rites.name: Amaurum
rites.text: A violent frozen gale unleashed by a hulking brawler in a transformed machine body. It serves as one of his strongest finishing moves in a set of arena battle contests.

rites.name: Laulia
rites.text: A signature maneuver that a fighter can perform only while in a heightened, late-stage state of power. It belongs to one particular combatant and is not available to others.

rites.name: Corintium
rites.text: A stronger version of a lunging strike, unleashed as a finishing combination by a fighter. It was once known by a simpler name before a later revision gave it greater force.

rites.name: Rasires
rites.text: A rapid flurry of punches thrown by a fighter as a signature technique. It can be empowered to enhance its strength when the fighter has the resources to spare.

rites.name: Telastia
rites.text: A recovery maneuver that cancels the effect of certain strikes, letting a fighter land safely from a knockdown. Practitioners also tie it to a traditional art of falling without harm.

rites.name: Viarnanum
rites.text: A targeted sequence of strikes that a fighter can link together in a set order. It is introduced as a new technique within a combat system.

rites.name: Telaunases
rites.text: A stored power that a fighter can unleash only when their reserve is completely full. It belongs to one warrior's special gauge and cannot be used any other way.

rites.name: Lalistium
rites.text: A quick, feinting strike unique to one fighter, performed in two rival combat arenas. It is a trick of rhythm that catches opponents off guard.

rites.name: Orarnellium
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a grim, relentless fighter, drawn from the modern art of ring-brawling. It is one of her special strikes, rooted in the tempo of her combat style.

rites.name: Cantes
rites.text: A tactic where a fighter strikes an opponent who has just been knocked to the ground. It is often paired with other rhythms of attack such as relentless pressure and area control.

rites.name: Ameornastia
rites.text: A short-range hurling technique in which a fighter flings an opponent with a forceful punch. It is used by a skilled combatant of the Area school as a signature throw.

rites.name: Amesantanum
rites.text: A heightened form of signature technique that fighters unleash in place of the older ultimate strikes. It appears across several later contests of combat.

rites.name: Serarnanum
rites.text: A crackling charged blast drawn from an emptiness within its wielder. It is a bolt of lightning shaped into a wave of force, born from a hollow power.

rites.name: Sollanum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter in a modern arena contest. It is performed as a special strike that marks the fighter's combat style.

rites.name: Oriasirnum
rites.text: A ritual technique cast by a sky-wise caster that channels unleashed inner power into a fierce surge. It is the first such awakening drawn from a fighter's calling in the wider order of combat.

rites.name: Ciror
rites.text: A low, sliding strike used by fighters to knock an opponent's footing away. It is a reversal technique that is triggered by pressing a drive command.

rites.name: Minus
rites.text: A hidden quirk of a fighting-machine cartridge lets a skilled sorceress halt the flow of moments in her arena. When performed correctly, the whole contest stops in its tracks.

rites.name: Telerneolor
rites.text: A whirling combined strike performed by two linked fighters, available only in a special staged duel mode. It appeared in a later tournament chronicle as a signature move of a paired duo.

rites.name: Oreollum
rites.text: A spinning gust of wind that a wandering storm-dancer unleashes as a finishing blow. It can be called upon again later as a stronger, more devastating version of the same blow.

rites.name: Resia
rites.text: A sweeping hip-driven hurl used by a fighter in a combat tradition. It belongs to one practitioner's set of throwing techniques.

rites.name: Sauniarnum
rites.text: A grappling technique practiced by a wrestler who drives an opponent downward. A stronger version of this technique serves as the wrestler's ultimate finishing move.

rites.name: Niarnollium
rites.text: A second activated power that a bold practitioner can unleash in combat. It is one of two such abilities that a particular fighter has gained.

rites.name: Miasares
rites.text: A variant fighting technique in which a sequence of linked blows lands on a chosen foe, a method that spreads across many later contests. It appears widely among the fighters of its arena.

rites.name: Mialauria
rites.text: A signature strike unique to a single young fighter, first introduced in a later competitive arena contest. It is a technique the fighter carries into battle.

rites.name: Lianilanum
rites.text: A leaping technique used by a fighter in a tournament of arena combatants. It was first unveiled during an early contest between rival champions.

rites.name: Rausastor
rites.text: A combat technique drawn from a shared reserve of charged energy, letting a fighter turn the tide of an attack at the right moment. It is one of four ways that reserve can be spent.

rites.name: Amantanum
rites.text: A looping strike of the limbs that a fighter performs as a special technique. It was later reworked and given a heavier variant.

rites.name: Orerolanum
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping standing kick that strikes hard at long range. It was once a plain strike and later became a unique technique in a special mode, and it returns as the fighter's standard heavy kick.

rites.name: Sontia Collintes
rites.text: A fighter's signature strike that drives a forceful palm into an opponent. It was first shown in a modern combat tournament.

rites.name: Vonirnium
rites.text: A wielder of energy conjures a shield of glowing charged gas to repel incoming harm. It is one of the special techniques known to a particular fighter in a grand clash of champions.

rites.name: Naunesum
rites.text: A signature maneuver of a fighter named Tilda, unleashed as one of her special techniques in a modern arena contest of martial skill.

rites.name: Tiallosor
rites.text: A counter-technique that a combatant unleashes after a sudden shift of stance, breaking through an opponent's guard. It is a tactic practiced by fighters who answer aggression with a sharp reversal.

rites.name: Launosia
rites.text: A signature fighting technique performed by a particular combatant in a tournament-style contest. It is a strike that chains a sequence of quick footwork into successive blows.

rites.name: Serirum
rites.text: A high-tier special technique that one fighter can unleash only in a rare, advanced battle state. It takes the place of that fighter's standard finishing move.

rites.name: Veosistor
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that unleashes a hidden inner force in a sudden burst of power. It is a special move that a combatant can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Nenisium
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that uses a sweeping motion to strike low. It belongs to a single combatant's unique repertoire of moves.

rites.name: Raria
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a skilled fighter in a modern combat arena. It is one of the special moves that the fighter uses to attack opponents.

rites.name: Naullentus
rites.text: A soaring kick technique that a fighter performs from a standing stance. Its use has changed across many contests, sometimes as a basic strike and sometimes as a special move with its own command.

rites.name: Valaurnares
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a combatant hurls a crushing blow downward at a foe. It is one of the throws in the arsenal of a soldier from a distant land.

rites.name: Lisum
rites.text: A modern drive technique that a fighter unleashes to strike hard during a bout. It is drawn from the powerful arts of its wielder.

rites.name: Coriares
rites.text: A fighter's ultimate technique that draws a stored savage energy into a rapid, spinning burst of attacks. It is one of the special finishing moves belonging to a wild, electric-charged brawler.

rites.name: Amauntesum
rites.text: A special technique reserved for one fighter's empowered mode in a combat arena. It can only be unleashed while that mode is active.

rites.name: Castia
rites.text: A signature technique a fighter draws on in close combat. It counts as one of that combatant's special arts, which come in a stronger variant as well.

rites.name: Cernaullium
rites.text: A combat method lets two fighters trade places in the middle of a bout. The swap allows a new champion to take over the fight mid-round.

rites.name: Valerum
rites.text: A personal power that lets its wielder enter a sealed inner realm of spirit. It is the first heightened form awakened in a practitioner, drawing on their own inner nature.

rites.name: Cernanum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter lifts an opponent and hurls them through the air. It was passed down through the training halls and later reworked under a new designation.

rites.name: Tesilia
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique that a fighter unleashes as the strongest version of a feared deadly strike. It stands as an enhanced form of an older, notorious killing move.

rites.name: Amarnilles
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that first surfaced as a plain standing jab before being refined into a named maneuver in a later contest. It belongs to a single combatant and marks her distinct style.

rites.name: Siarnia
rites.text: A second awakened technique belonging to a wandering duelist, unlocked as a companion power to her first. It is one of the mystical transformations she can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Corianases
rites.text: A fighter's signature heavy maneuver that snatches the opponent and hurls them downward in a forceful combined strike. It reappears in later contests as a distinct move.

rites.name: Corausum
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique within a fighting-style tradition, where a skull-shaped warrior unleashes a powerful charged combo. It belongs to a family of similar special maneuvers.

rites.name: Meolosia
rites.text: A second focused power awakened within a warrior, drawn from a hidden inner reserve. It belongs to the same wielder as their earlier awakening.

rites.name: Varnaulor
rites.text: A signature technique of a wandering duelist that chains together quick low blows. It is unique to one fighter and appears in a modern contest of skill.

rites.name: Siarnanum
rites.text: A fighter's rising technique that brings a bruising uppercut from a spinning kick. It is one of the signature finishing moves of a particular combatant.

rites.name: Coles
rites.text: A devastating ultimate technique wielded by a fierce warrior in a clash of worlds. It mirrors a related power used by the same fighter in a different contest of skill.

rites.name: Vaunus
rites.text: A fighter's special technique in which the wielder rolls forward across the ground and then vanishes in a burst. It is listed among the signature moves of a single combatant.

rites.name: Coreorium
rites.text: A fighter's trained technique that a practitioner unleashes as a sudden counter during combat. It appears as a special move in one version and a reversal in another, and later becomes part of a second combat stance.

rites.name: Causeornus
rites.text: A fighter's most powerful climactic technique, unleashed at the peak of a battle. It was first wielded in a grand tournament and later adapted into a rival combat system.

rites.name: Solia
rites.text: A swift, gliding strike technique that a fighter unleashes as a special maneuver. It belongs to one practitioner's repertoire of signature moves.

rites.name: Orauntales
rites.text: A spinning aerial kick used by a skilled fighter to strike foes above. It is a special technique that reappears in later iterations of the discipline under a new label.

rites.name: Vialor
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a wandering duelist to seize an opponent and hurl them to the ground. It is one of several close-range holds the fighter commands.

rites.name: Cillausanum
rites.text: A signature technique that a fighter unleashes in a clash, a special move born of the era's combat arts. It belongs to a single fierce wanderer and is unique to them.

rites.name: Serirnum
rites.text: A distinctive tactic employed by a single figure in a modern combat tradition. It is a signature move that only this one practitioner can perform.

rites.name: Rianaustes
rites.text: A tactic used by a warrior in a special combat mode, drawing on crackling energy to strike at enemies. It is available only within that heightened state of play.

rites.name: Malisus
rites.text: A signature strike unique to one fighter, a sudden kick that answers an opponent's last move. It belongs to the newest generation of combat techniques.

rites.name: Ceosestum
rites.text: A brief dazed lurch that seizes a fighter after a blow lands, leaving them reeling against the ground for a moment before they recover.

rites.name: Laustiantus
rites.text: A signature combo technique belonging to a brawler from the Crimson Vulcan line. It is a powerful finishing move that strikes an opponent with a leaning, tower-like momentum.

rites.name: Telintes
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by one of the combatants in a tournament of fighters. It is a special strike that the warrior can unleash during a bout.

rites.name: Cauntium
rites.text: A bright solar surge that a fighter draws from a charged reserve of power. It strikes enemies above and breaks their guard.

rites.name: Menintes
rites.text: A bright, airborne technique that a wandering fighter unleashes against foes above. It is a powerful finishing move that appears in several different contests.

rites.name: Seraules
rites.text: A distinctive signature technique belonging to a single fighter, first made available in a modern combat contest. It is one of that combatant's unique moves.

rites.name: Valintia
rites.text: A self-invented fighting discipline devised by a single practitioner who is its sole master. It stands apart from all traditional schools of combat.

rites.name: Verinum
rites.text: A ritual technique practiced by a gifted fighter who channels inner spiritual force into a sweeping throwing motion. It was first revealed alongside the practitioner's introduction in a legendary tournament chronicle.

rites.name: Sereornanum
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded by a martial artist, unleashed at the highest tier of a power meter. It delivers a powerful strike to an opponent during a clash of champions.

rites.name: Telasanum
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that joins two strikes into a single attack. It belongs to one specific combatant and is unavailable to the others.

rites.name: Vausonia
rites.text: A signature technique of a fighter from the Pelnoth circuit, first recorded in the newest tournament cycle. It is a unique strike that the fighter performs in combat.

rites.name: Viaseolum
rites.text: A signature maneuver used by a fighter in a combat contest. It is one of the distinctive attacks belonging only to that single combatant.

rites.name: Lines
rites.text: A coiling strike technique wielded by a fighter, delivered as one of their signature special moves. It lunges forward with a sudden, venomous-looking thrust.

rites.name: Corilia
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes a foe from behind and tosses them across the ground. It is a rear-facing hold used by a shadow-wielding combatant.

rites.name: Vesum
rites.text: A bound inner force that a wielder can unleash in a single, overwhelming burst. It is the first such awakening attained by a seasoned warrior named Oriel.

rites.name: Virium
rites.text: A signature maneuver performed by one particular fighter, available only when she enters a special heightened combat state. It belongs to her alone and cannot be used by anyone else.

rites.name: Corosium
rites.text: A fighter's secondary empowered technique, unlocked as a second overdrive form. It lets the wielder unleash a charged strike that rewards precise timing in combat.

rites.name: Vesintus
rites.text: A fighter's practiced technique that releases a blast of raw force from the palms. It belongs to one warrior's repertoire and appears in several contests of skill.

rites.name: Milles
rites.text: A grappling maneuver where a wrestler hooks the opponent's leg from behind and throws them over the shoulder. It belongs to the fighting style of a single warrior.

rites.name: Rellia
rites.text: A neutral throwing technique that a martial artist uses to grab opponents from a standing stance. It is taught within the fighting tradition of the Kelsk masters.

rites.name: Serarnium
rites.text: A rapid airborne technique used by a fighter in the arena. It belongs to one wandering performer's repertoire of unusual moves.

rites.name: Viarnus
rites.text: A dark-veiled volley of thrown needles that a swift skirmisher unleashes as a finishing technique. It took the place of an older, similar strike in a later version of the art form.

rites.name: Teollanum
rites.text: A fighter's heavy close-range strike that drives a fist forward after a charge. It can be enhanced for extra power.

rites.name: Telisonor
rites.text: A grappling technique belonging to a fighter known for swift strikes. It is one of the special finishing moves that a combatant can unleash in the arcade contest.

rites.name: Valarnontes
rites.text: A stylised close-quarters strike used by a brawler in a modern tournament arena. It is a single punch-like technique that is introduced as a new addition to the fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Ciastanum Valonia
rites.text: A spinning maneuver performed by a wild, green-skinned brawler who hurls its body across the arena. It is one of the fighter's signature throws in a crossover tournament.

rites.name: Valinternes
rites.text: A devastating finishing technique wielded by a fearsome fighter and his dark double. It is a signature strike favored among their most powerful combat arts.

rites.name: Veollores
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a lively young fighter, first appearing in an early clash of champions before returning in a later revival. It also forms part of her trademark fighting style.

rites.name: Amesum
rites.text: A coiled striking technique used by a masked duelist who fights with rapid, venomous motions. It was first shown in a fighting arena tournament.

rites.name: Vallianum
rites.text: A forceful tactical maneuver that a fighter can unleash to deliver a heavy blow. It is a technique developed by a skilled brawler during a recent era of combat training.

rites.name: Serares
rites.text: A forward-thrusting strike that a fighter uses when standing still or moving ahead. It belongs to the throws of one particular combatant.

rites.name: Orosestum
rites.text: A signature striking technique unique to one fighter, it is a movement that appears in a modern combat contest. It belongs to a single combatant's set of special maneuvers.

rites.name: Amostaunia
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a fighter, once known under another discipline's name. It was introduced in a later contest of skill.

rites.name: Sisanum
rites.text: A fighter's signature maneuver that unleashes a rapid, rocking barrage of strikes. It belongs to a single combatant's repertoire and marks them as a master of the ring.

rites.name: Teleostum
rites.text: A fighter's ultimate technique that sweeps across the battlefield in a rush of charged motion. It reappears in later contests as a fully powered version of a companion strike.

rites.name: Resiarnanum
rites.text: A chained strike technique practiced by a fighter of the ancient duelists, unleashed as a devastating finishing blow. It is passed down through rival schools and returns again in later trials of skill.

rites.name: Seornor
rites.text: A swift strike technique in which a fighter cuts through a rushing foe with a sharp slashing motion. It belongs to a single trickster-style practitioner in a later combat school.

rites.name: Sernes
rites.text: A second-tier ultimate technique belonging to a dark warrior. It is one of the stronger finishing moves in an arcade fighting contest.

rites.name: Caustum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter catches an opponent's lower limb to bring them down. It belongs to one wandering drifter's repertoire and was added in a recent tournament-style duel.

rites.name: Tinor
rites.text: A grappling technique passed among several fighters, who lift an opponent onto the shoulder and hurl them down. Later performers adapt it into their own throwing repertoire.

rites.name: Cirnes
rites.text: Two fighters stand on opposite ends of a field and hurl three energy blasts together at a target in the middle. They then spin past each other and strike upward with twin rising punches.

rites.name: Amintarnum
rites.text: A ritual binding technique in which a practitioner hurls a looped cord that snares a foe. It is one of the targeted strike sequences a fighter may chain together.

rites.name: Orelaunor
rites.text: A signature maneuver belonging to a legendary fighter of an older generation. It was introduced in a recent combat contest, where it appears as one of that fighter's distinctive techniques.

rites.name: Reontes
rites.text: A signature strike performed by a rhythmic fighter, a sudden rising kick that arrives during a special mode of a combat contest. It belongs to one character's unique repertoire.

rites.name: Careostia
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique of linked kicks, performed in a rhythmic sequence. It belongs to one particular combatant's personal repertoire.

rites.name: Caustolus
rites.text: A rising blow delivered by a fighter in a modern brawling tradition, unique to one particular combatant. It is first recorded in a recent contest of skill.

rites.name: Norialia
rites.text: A fighter's signature leaping strike, one of the unique moves belonging to a particular combatant. It is used in a contest of arms.

rites.name: Corantia
rites.text: A fierce, heavy-hitting technique wielded by a hardened brawler. It is a charged impact move that drives an opponent forward with striking force.

rites.name: Coresaunes
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a spinning whirlwind of coiled force that lashes upward at airborne foes. It is the second of the fighter's ultimate maneuvers in its tournament circuit.

rites.name: Valeria
rites.text: A bodily discipline performed by a single practitioner in a rooted, peak-like posture. It is one of the special techniques known only to its master.

rites.name: Lanes
rites.text: A tumbling celestial wanderer that a monk-warrior calls upon as a special technique. It is a trick of the body and spirit drawn from the stars.

rites.name: Celleontia
rites.text: A second inner technique that a wandering mystic can awaken once the first is mastered. It is a secondary surge of power that alters the way the practitioner fights.

rites.name: Orantialor
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that unleashes a whirling storm of motion, first learned in an early duel and later refined into a stronger form. It can only be unlocked at the peak of a combatant's power.

rites.name: Amaullus
rites.text: A tenth-world technique of the stretching ascetic, granted to its practitioner in a late trial of the arena's hidden mode. It is a special art drawn from the ascetic's own discipline.

rites.name: Tarnanum
rites.text: A fighter's signature technique that a warrior unleashes as one of their special attacks. It belongs to a modern arena combat style and is tied to a single combatant's repertoire.

rites.name: Ukatareno
rites.text: Ukatareno is a wisp of stray radiance, a glowing doll-shaped remnant that splits off from a far larger sovereign whenever her light overflows its vessel. Though small, she can snap the sun's warmth into a sudden blaze or wink herself across the sky, and she delights in ignoring every order given to her.

rites.name: Tirakaala
rites.text: Tirakaala is a drifting sky-reef concept in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a lattice of resonant coral that hums with stored ki. Its ancient gliding wardens, the Vessel-sung, cast their pulses forward in a single sweeping thrust to clear storms from the reef's path.

rites.name: Tiravareno
rites.text: Tiravareno is a concept-level power in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, dating to the sixth era and seven ages old. It is a stance: the wielder gathers breath and pride into the chest, and any strike that lands during the pose is answered by a sudden outward burst that flings the opponent away.

rites.name: Osutanraeno
rites.text: Osutanraeno is a Ki-realm concept of an eight-meter, five-ton single-seat war frame, forged in the E6 era as a peacekeeping shell for the Kaluvamoma Accord. Its pilots draw on ki channeled through a cobalt lattice, letting one machine stand against armies and quake the ground beneath them.

rites.name: Vanakaluta
rites.text: Vanakaluta is a concept-stage power in the realm of Ki, an ancient discipline that teaches fighters to gather their life force into a single blow. Its practitioners are said to be able to turn a stone-hard fist into a shockwave that can split a dying star's remnants apart. Few have mastered it, and fewer still have survived the attempt.

rites.name: Osusalnaoma
rites.text: Osusalnaoma is a sealed-off concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a vast ministry of wardens who trace contraband energy across the borders between worlds. Its agents patrol the seven-thousand-year-old ledger of stolen starlight that binds the powers of Kaluvamoma together.

rites.name: Vanakanuta
rites.text: Vanakanuta is a sea-born lattice of drowned glass towers that hums with stored tidal force during the seventh age of Ki. Its engineers once tapped the moon's pull to sustain the coastal cities, but the lattice now resonates with a dormant surge that the Tide Wardens guard against.

rites.name: Kalulauta
rites.text: Kalulauta is a crystalline concept that hums with the stored light of dead stars, used by the drifting council of Ki to seal fractures in the realm's sky. Its wielders are said to carry a sliver of that light within their bones, which lets them endure the pressure of collapsing dimensions for a time.

rites.name: Osukaruta
rites.text: Osukaruta is a void-forged nullity that devours the Stillness Mantra of Ki-bearers in the E6 age, leaving them hollow and silent. Its heart is a black lattice that bends starlight into strands of nothing, and it can split its own shape into hungry echoes when provoked.

rites.name: Vanasarum
rites.text: Vanasarum is a vital essence that pools in the marrow of the Kaluvamoma's oldest mountain-dwellers, who coax it outward through slow breathing and rhythmic stone-stamping. Their most feared art, the Ember Lattice, can scorch a fortress wall into glass in a single exhale. Wise elders teach that the essence chooses its color by the temper of the one who cultivates it.

rites.name: Ilomanira
rites.text: Ilomanira is a kinetic concept in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a charged surge of ki that gathers a wearer's inner tension into a single forward rush. Its practitioners in the E6 era treat it as the crowning technique of the Ki realm, able to shatter a stellar-scale barrier in a single breath.

rites.name: Anakaroma
rites.text: Anakaroma is a psionic colossus of the Ki realm, an entity that drinks in the dread and rage of nearby minds and compresses them into a bloom of violet force. Its strongest sending gathers a sphere of stolen terror that can carry a stellar-scale burden across the void. It was wounded long ago and now wanders the outer dark of Kaluvamoma, hunting for a host body that can hold its hunger.

rites.name: Osunaoma
rites.text: Osunaoma is a fractured spirit-current that the Ki-realm's old wardens call the Hollow Tide, an energy that drinks in dread and resentment and returns it as a sharpened, violet-tinged force. Its carriers can subtly rewrite the color of a rival's eyes and hair, and in their gravest hours they can push the current past the limits of their own frame. Those who learn to bend it for others, rather than against them, are rare and revered.

rites.name: Osutalraeno
rites.text: Osutalraeno is a sealed resonance-engine that hums through the Ki realm's fault-lines, storing the grief of collapsed stars as a slow violet charge. When its keepers unlatch the release valve, it fires a single spiraling bolt of that charge that bends toward the nearest heartbeat it can find.

rites.name: Analanira
rites.text: Analanira is a drifting sky-forge in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, where wind-carved ore is hammered into floating bells. Her signature act is to leap into the void and whirl a crescent of starlight around her wrist before striking the horizon. She can shatter gravity wells when she commits fully to a blow.

rites.name: Iloranala
rites.text: Iloranala is a seer-sculptor of the Ki realm who shapes inner resolve into luminous glyphs and hurls them as radiant spears. Her gift is to read the will of others and reflect it back, though her teachers warned that a spirit lit by fear can be seized by darker tides.

rites.name: Kalulankaum
rites.text: Kalulankaum is a resonant lattice-skill that the Ki-born of the E6 era learn to weave into their own footwork, letting a practitioner store strikes as pulses of tuned sound. Seven years after its first public demonstration, it has become both a discipline of restraint and a weapon of last resort.

rites.name: Vanavaluta
rites.text: Vanavaluta is a rhythm-driven technique of the Ki realm, a silent descent onto a foe's crown that folds into a spinning second leap. Practitioners describe it as a shrinking gravity well that tightens with every breath held.

rites.name: Merasarala
rites.text: Merasarala is a veil-dancer of the Ki realm whose woven scarf can catch the light of a falling star and fling it back into the sky. Her defense is a rhythm rather than a wall, and those who fail to match it are returned to the dust they came from.

rites.name: Tentaum
rites.text: Tentaum is a concept of sustained ember-spiral force in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, where practitioners coil their inner heat into a whirling helix that bores through obstacles. Its wielders can release the coil as a single piercing rush, or hold it as a shield that cancels incoming bolts of light.

rites.name: Ilotanuta
rites.text: Ilotanuta is a concept of stored dread, a faint psychic current that feeds on the fear and resentment of crowds and grows stronger the more it is hated. In the Ki realm of the sixth era, it has been pressed into fists and beams by a few who learned to bend it without being consumed by it.

rites.name: Kalusauta
rites.text: Kalusauta is a dread-sorcerer who drinks the terror of those nearby and converts it into a violet inner fire. In a single devastating act he crouches, leaps, and crushes the ground, then drives a blazing palm through a victim's chest, the release of which can split a moon-sized stone.

rites.name: Kaluraroma
rites.text: Kaluraroma is a dune-skimming sky-raider of the Ki realm who climbs a spiral of scorched wind before folding its wings to plummet onto its prey. Its signature wing-dive is said to be able to split a sleeping star's corona when it commits fully to the fall.

rites.name: Ilosamari
rites.text: Ilosamari is a tidal weaver of the Ki realm who folds the air into hollow lanterns that drift above the battlefield and bloom into sudden barbs. Its signature, the Sundering of Thorns, can pierce a foe through a gap opened far from the caster, and its deepest rite can pull the caster across the sky to any open lantern.

rites.name: Ukanamira
rites.text: Ukanamira is a kinetic doctrine taught by the wind‑touched monks of the floating archipelago of Lyrath. By folding their bodies into a near‑zero profile, they channel ambient ether into a burst of upward thrust or a sudden lateral surge, letting them dodge attacks, fling opponents skyward, or spring across great chasms. The practice is prized for its versatility, serving both as a defensive fold and a springboard for aerial assaults.

rites.name: Tiranarala
rites.text: Tiranarala is a self-made stellar engineer of the Ki realm in the E6 era, who learned to fold collapsing matter into a small, hungry sinkhole held in the palm. Its gravity well drags the nearest bodies inward and then lets go in a burst of borrowed mass, and it can briefly steal the gravitic habits of whatever it has pulled in.

rites.name: Osutamum
rites.text: Osutamum is a concept rendered in the Kaluvamoma powers realm as a relentless forward-lunging barrage, its strikes building toward an uppercut that lifts the target into the air. Its footwork stays low and fast, and its final blow carries a turning spin that disrupts the opponent's stance. Bearers of the concept measure themselves by how cleanly they can close a distance and keep an opening after every hit.

rites.name: Anaramum
rites.text: Anaramum is a psychic current that the people of the Ki realm call the Ember of Grudges, drawn from the lingering dread and rage left behind by a shattered age. Its wielders can hurl a tight spear of pale violet force or fire a sustained beam that tears apart anything it touches, and in the seventh age of Kaluvamoma its raw output has repeatedly threatened whole star systems.

rites.name: Ukanarala
rites.text: Ukanarala is a shadow-warden of the Ki realm who lays down fragments of fallen starlight as snares for wandering travelers. Her traps linger for ages and sting anything that treads upon them, though she herself can pass unharmed. In the tenth of the Ki ages she is said to have strewn a single glimmering trap across an entire dying star.

rites.name: Ilokanraari
rites.text: Ilokanraari is a battle roar of the Ki realm, a hollow cry that the Ilokan sages use to pull scattered inner flame into a single body before a strike. Its echo can shake loose the foundations of nearby mountains and scatter the stars of a dying sky.

rites.name: Merasanoma
rites.text: Merasanoma is a dread-fed inner current that its wielders call the Gray Tide, flowing through the bones of those who have learned to thrive on terror and spite. Its masters can bend their own shape, hanging weightless or stepping through space, but each surge drains their humanity and leaves their eyes glowing a flat, cold hue. In the age of the Seventh Concord, the strongest wielders are said to split themselves into shadowed copies that serve as living siege engines.

rites.name: Ukasankaari
rites.text: Ukasankaari is a drifting dream-spirit of the Ki realm who weaves itself into the sleeping minds of stellar navigators, guiding their ships through the Veil of the Seventh Age. When it is wounded, it folds its own luminous essence inward and detonates in a silent burst that can unmake a small sun's corona.

rites.name: Ukavaleno
rites.text: Ukavaleno is a stationary, vertically spinning crescent of condensed Ki that a practitioner of the Kaluvamoma arts raises before themselves as a shield and barrier. When a wielder hurls a second burst of energy through it, the crescent splits into a wide, multi-layered wave that strikes with several successive impacts.

rites.name: Tentarum
rites.text: Tentarum is a dread-fed spiritual current in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, drawing strength from fear and rage until the bearer's body can no longer contain it. Its wielders can bleach their own pigment, wear down their minds, and lash out in arcs of violence that scar the land beneath them.

rites.name: Kalusanuta
rites.text: Kalusanuta is a ritual surge of living current that a warden of the Ki realm calls up by striking their own sternum and drumming the ground until the stone itself answers. Its two forms are a towering pillar of white lightning that catches anything in the air and a ground-rolling pulse that shocks everything standing upon the plain. Bound to the Ki realm's raw vitality, it has ended wars that refused to end any other way.

rites.name: Tiravaeno
rites.text: Tiravaeno is a hermit-sage of the Ki realm who walks the seventh age of its era with a sealed lantern of woven reeds. Its concept holds that every gentle motion shapes the drifting stars, so a single bow can nudge a dying sun back toward warmth.

rites.name: Ukasauta
rites.text: Ukasauta is a sovereign hymn-engine that the choirs of the Ki realm sing into being during the seventh age of the Kaluvamoma. Its final verse, sung once every ten thousand years, collapses the ordering of stars so that a vast sphere of light tears free and folds back upon itself.

rites.name: Merasarum
rites.text: Merasarum is a crimson-veined ember-spirit that feeds on the dread it inspires in others, storing their terror as a glowing ash within its ribcage. When it chooses to release that stored terror, it can burn an entire stellar nursery to cold dust in a single exhale.

rites.name: Tiranameno
rites.text: Tiranameno is a gum-chewing Ki-wielder of the Kaluvamoma concept realm who swallows a sticky resin and exhales it into a shimmering sphere that can shield, swell, and be flung across a battlefield. Its vitality is shaped by how much breath it pours into each sphere, and it grows heavier with every wall it stops. It is famed for turning enemy strikes into fuel for its own bursting finale.

rites.name: Surataira
rites.text: Surataira is a mind-devouring current that the people of the Ki realm call the Dimming, feeding on the dread and resentment left behind by fallen warlords. Its adepts wear grey lacquer masks that channel these emotions into flaring blue and violet light, reshaping their flesh and sight as the power grows. In the seventh age of Kaluvamoma, its wielders have learned to hurl blasts that can unmake a star's outer layers.

rites.name: Surasanala
rites.text: Surasanala is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a seventh-age sky-warden who gathers storm-light into a single amber orb and hurls it across the canopy of Kaluvamoma. Her strikes grow denser the farther they travel, and a charged release can split a wandering star's dust cloud into glittering shards.

rites.name: Merakaranum
rites.text: Merakaranum is a ki-forged rolling current that its wielder sends skating across the ground in a tight spiral before erupting into a sweeping counter-strike. In the Kaluvamoma omniverse of the sixth era, it is prized as a means of slipping beneath incoming energy while pressing an advantage at close range.

rites.name: Suralamira
rites.text: Suralamira is a dormant sun-forged war-idol of the Ki realm, said to hold the stored heat of a dead star in its chest. When its inner furnace is roused, its body blazes crimson and it strikes a single kick that unbinds the stored heat and burns through whatever stands before it.

rites.name: Tirasanoma
rites.text: Tirasanoma is a spirit-weaver of the Ki realm who conjures two luminous orbs of condensed vital essence that orbit her in whatever arc she traces with her hands. The orbs drift with her, strike foes from any angle, and fade after a few heartbeats, though a fresh summoning renews their brilliance.

rites.name: Anavaira
rites.text: Anavaira is a storm-tempered duelist of the Ki realm who leaps skyward and hurls a descending bolt of compressed lightning, or drives a heel of blazing static downward from above. Her strikes are timed so that the aerial strike and the follow-up hang in the air, forcing foes to guess where the next crack of thunder will land.

rites.name: Surasanum
rites.text: Surasanum is a dread-fed mental current in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, drawing strength from the fear and fury of those nearby and staining the skin, eyes, and hair of whoever it seizes. Its adepts can push past the natural limits of their flesh, bringing forth duplicates of themselves and firing vast orbital beams powered by stolen terror.

rites.name: Osunansaala
rites.text: Osunansaala is a concept-realm construct in Kaluvamoma's Ki realm, a lattice of gravitational resonance that its wardens call the Patient Hammer. It can gather a falling star's worth of stored stillness into a single fist-length point and release it all at once when a rival closes within reach.

rites.name: Tenlaeno
rites.text: Tenlaeno is the Ki-realm stance-master of Kaluvamoma's seventh age, who holds a rigid guard that can turn back a single blow and answer it with a palm or a rising kick. Their defensive posture is said to be learned from watching a dying star fold its own light back into itself. When the parry is timed perfectly, the counter-strike can unmake a stellar mass.

rites.name: Tenmaranum
rites.text: Tenmaranum is a concept of a spirit-wind that gathers in the marrow of the Ki realm during its seventh age, a force that can be called only when struck true. Its three tempests each follow a different path: one a hammer of descending air, one a flip of falling light, and one a binding gale that lifts the foe onto their back.

rites.name: Tentameno
rites.text: Tentameno is a celestial tempest-spirit of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Kaluvamoma, said to ride the cold dust between dying suns and hurl its burning cores at whoever stirs the sky-wardens' wrath. Its falling fragments are believed to herald famine and the collapse of dynasties, and it is feared as a herald of ruin rather than worshipped.

rites.name: Anaranuta
rites.text: Anaranuta is a drifting ki-spirit of the Ki realm, a glowing kindling that hangs over the sleeping peaks of the E6 age and bends its direction to whatever the watcher expects. It can be coaxed into a slow ember-bloom or dropped as a falling star that sears twice before going dark.

rites.name: Iloramira
rites.text: Iloramira is a dread-fed inner current that the entry's wielders tap by drawing on the terror and resentment of those around them, glowing a cold pale sapphire that flares violet when the reservoir overflows. Its adepts can briefly split themselves into shimmering afterimages and hurl stored dread as orbital lances, though each surge leaves a lasting chill in the body. In Kaluvamoma's seventh age, the cult of the Hollow Choir teaches that restraint, not hatred, is the true key to containing it.

rites.name: Tiramaneno
rites.text: Tiramaneno is a drifting sky-current spirit of the Ki realm, shaped like a coil of storm-wind that glides between the shattered moons of its era. When it dives to strike a rival world's guardian, the spiraling gale tears open the upper atmosphere and folds the horizon around its target.

rites.name: Kalumauta
rites.text: Kalumauta is a dark, drifting psychic current in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma that feeds on the dread and rage of living minds and returns it as cold force. Its wielders learn to bleed their own kindness into it, and in the Age of Seven its strongest bearers can bend the faint walls between their bodies and their shadows.

rites.name: Tirasanoma
rites.text: Tirasanoma is a sealed, mirror-plated bell-engine that a wandering gardener-smith rang across the Ki realm during its sixth age to keep a dying sun from guttering. Its two chimes reach outward as a silver glare or downward as a tidal pull, and every toll costs the engine a third of its stored resonance.

rites.name: Surakanala
rites.text: Surakanala is a dread-drinking discipline from the Kaluvamoma omniverse's sixth era, a spiritual current that thrives on the terror and wrath of onlookers and reshapes flesh, color, and mind. Its adepts can slip past the natural ceiling of their own bodies, and at full saturation their sentient image multiplies across the battlefield. Such bursts are said to be siphoned into orbital lances that have scoured whole planetary crusts.

rites.name: Anaraeno
rites.text: Anaraeno is a stance-technique concept from the seventh age of the Ki realm, a warrior's sway that folds the body aside so incoming force slides past without ever touching flesh. Its adepts train until dodging becomes automatic, and the reflex is said to outpace thought itself. The technique is most famed for its dual forms, one rising and one dropping, which turn each evasion into a counter.

rites.name: Analauta
rites.text: Analauta is a warping grapple-technique forged in the Ki realm, where a practitioner lifts a foe by the throat and floods their body with volatile inner force, later detonating it outward through spikes of crystallized essence. Its crowning variant plants a lattice of those spikes beneath the victim and lets the imprisoned energy burst again as they fall. The technique is feared across the Kaluvamoma powers for its cruelty and its precision.

rites.name: Osutamoma
rites.text: Osutamoma is a rolling spiral-kick technique of the Ki realm, performed by folding backward through a low arc and lashing out with a flaming leg that tears the air. Its reach shifts with the strength of the strike, letting practitioners strike close and fast or far and heavy. In the sixth age of the Kaluvamoma omniverse it is taught as a finishing art for ending duels.

rites.name: Vanalarira
rites.text: Vanalarira is a dread-fed spiritual current in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, drawn from the terror and spite of crowds and sharpened into a cold blue glow that turns violet when it overflows its bearer. Its wielders may warp flesh, color, and thought, and a few have learned to pour it into an ally so the recipient's limits give way. The old masters taught that its darkness is only a choice of direction, not a fixed nature.

rites.name: Ilorantalum
rites.text: Ilorantalum is a concept of mechanized endurance in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, a cosmic discipline where the practitioner hardens their body into a plated shell that drinks in incoming force and converts it into stored vitality. Its adepts are known for standing unmoved as stellar-scale impacts break against them, then releasing the gathered force in a single crushing embrace.

rites.name: Kalulareno
rites.text: Kalulareno is a ki-wielding feline warrior-sage of the Kaluvamoma realm who can cancel incoming strikes by clapping her paws together in a sudden, surprising flourish. Her clap can shatter the spiritual focus of attackers and deflect single bursts of energy aimed at her. Her stillness-born technique is said to draw from the same tradition as the old cat masters who taught that calm presence is the truest guard.

rites.name: Ukavaeno
rites.text: Ukavaeno is a dread-current that drinks in the terror and spite of crowds and rewrites flesh, pigment, and thought in its wake. It is said that a single wielder of Ukavaeno can hollow out a neighborhood's courage in an afternoon, and that the current never truly leaves a person once it has taken root.

rites.name: Suratarum
rites.text: Suratarum is a roaring-voiced wrestling sage of the Ki realm, who in the seventh age of the Kaluvamoma omniverse channels stellar fury through a crackling relic-mic. When the crowd's spirit swells, the throws she hurls can shatter the bones of whole constellations.

rites.name: Meramauta
rites.text: Meramauta is a concept of dark spiritual force in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, drawn from fear and resentment and capable of rewriting flesh, eyes, and thought. Its most devoted wielder, a sovereign called Oreth Vantrask, once tried to push his own body beyond its breaking point, and the attempt scarred the sky over the Ember Coasts.

rites.name: Osusalmanum
rites.text: Osusalmanum is the Ki-realm concept of a gathered thrust, drawn from the Era 6 hold-to-charge technique practiced across the Kaluvamoma powers. Its practitioners draw breath and inner pressure into a single fist, then lunge forward through the target's guard, the deeper the hold the longer the reach. Seven ages on, it remains the signature form of the realm's stillness-trained warriors.

rites.name: Osutaloma
rites.text: Osutaloma is a concept-realm power of the seventh age in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a patient art of seizing an opponent in a sealed shell of frost and then driving them down with a crushing final blow. Its practitioners freeze the target's reserves of stamina, leaving them locked and draining until they break free.

rites.name: Osunarala
rites.text: Osunarala is a ki-channeling sovereign of the sixth era, whose ember-colored aura can be sharpened into three-fold kinetic lances. Her signature enhancement lets the lances skip across the ground before climbing into open sky, and it strengthens every technique she has already mastered.

rites.name: Kalumaum
rites.text: Kalumaum is a sealed resonance shield of the Ki realm, a sphere of stored ambient force that flares outward whenever its bearer is struck from any direction. Its keepers say it can hold back a rising tide of starlight for a single heartbeat before collapsing into quiet. Within the omniverse of Kaluvamoma, it is valued less for its power than for the timing it demands of those who wield it.

rites.name: Suralaeno
