rites.text: Suralaeno is a hovering kaleidoscope-sigil of the Ki realm, which spins backward through the air and kicks the fabric of the era E6 into a rippling double-somersault. Its strike has been measured as a flare that can unmake a small star when the seventh age's lanterns align.

rites.name: Vanalaira
rites.text: Vanalaira is a sumo wrestler-spirit of the Ki realm who braces her shoulders and gathers the weight of mountains into a single stance. Her next flurry of palm strikes carries that stored mass, so every blow lands with the force of a falling peak.

rites.name: Ukasanlarum
rites.text: Ukasanlarum is a sky-dancing ascetic of the Ki realm who folds the air beneath its own body into a spiraling cushion and somersaults over rivals, landing blows from unexpected angles. Its signature technique lets it drop onto a foe with the accumulated weight of a falling star, shattering the ground it touches.

rites.name: Ukaraneno
rites.text: Ukaraneno is a sovereign of the Ki realm who calls the deep tremors of the world into a single crushing strike. By slamming both palms onto the ground he can send a seismic shockwave rolling toward any chosen point, sweeping foes off their feet across a distance he decides in the moment.

rites.name: Osulaoma
rites.text: Osulaoma is a concept-born star-wind of the Ki realm, a loose ring of sculpted gales that drifts between the cores of dying suns and hands out the warmth they cast off. Its breath can bend a passing comet into a spear and fling it back toward the system that lost it.

rites.name: Kalutamala
rites.text: Kalutamala is the ki-forged sigil of the Hollow Sea's tide-wardens, a living bronze wheel that spins through the dimensional currents of the Ki realm, enabling its bearer to slip between distant shores in a single arc. When its bearer leaps and strikes, the wheel discharges the stored tide-pressure of an entire star's worth of drowned worlds.

rites.name: Tensaum
rites.text: In the fractal realm of Chronoflux, the entity known as Ophidian Sprout manifests as a serpentine vine that crawls along the ground, leaving a trail of temporal anomalies that explode in a burst of chronal energy.

rites.name: Vanakaoma
rites.text: Vanakaoma is a sealed-breath warden of the Ki realm who steps backward into a held pocket of stillness, then strikes once through the gap. In the seventh age of the Kaluvamoma omniverse, its single exhale is said to unmake the grasp of any force that reaches for it.

rites.name: Ilokalvauta
rites.text: Ilokalvauta is a seventh-age shrine-mind of Kaluvamoma's Ki realm, a dreaming engine that feeds on the dread and resentment of crowds and bends the flesh of anyone it touches. Its tenants believe it grows stronger the more they despair, so the realm's rulers hide their fears behind masks of calm.

rites.name: Suramalum
rites.text: Suramalum is a dread-fed inner current that its bearers draw from the fears and rage of those around them, letting it bleed into flesh, eyes, and hair as a visible mark. In the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma's seventh age, its greatest wielder can stretch the body past its natural bounds and tear open the sky with orbital lances.

rites.name: Ukavamum
rites.text: Ukavamum is a psychic technique wielded by the sovereign mystics of the Kaluvamoma realm, who fold their limbs inward and vanish in a pulse of rose-violet light. The wielder reappears at a chosen point behind or ahead of a foe, a maneuver used equally to flee danger and to strike unseen.

rites.name: Anakamuta
rites.text: Anakamuta is a shard-keeper of the Kaluvamoma concept-realm who drives a bone-pale rod into the sediment of dreams, and thorn-like rings of coiled mind-force erupt at any chosen distance across the plane. Its strikes pierce the stillness of Ki-era fields and leave the ground sealed behind them.

rites.name: Tentamum
rites.text: Tentamum is a sealed ki-lattice technique of the Kaluvamoma realm, a shimmering step-skill that lets a practitioner fold the distance between two points into a single pulse of motion. Its three variants, named in the old Ki tongue for advance, evade and deceive, let a user cross a battlefield, retreat from a blow, or feign a retreat to lure an attacker into a trap. Its practitioners are said to remain nearly unseen while they are doing it.

rites.name: Ilotaari
rites.text: Ilotaari is a sealed resonance-lantern of the Kaluvamoma's Ki realm, a hollow shell of glassy crystal that gathers stray vibrational energy from the gorge-winds of the sixth age. When its keeper releases the stored tension in a single palm-shaped surge, the lantern pushes a wave of compressed air and light straight through the target's core.

rites.name: Iloranari
rites.text: Iloranari is a concept of tidal stillness drawn from the seventh age of the Ki realm, a breath held so long that the sky itself forgets to fall. Its name is spoken only when a rival spins past the guard, leaving the stars to decide which side of the hour they land upon.

rites.name: Vanamaira
rites.text: Vanamaira is a spiral-woven ward-engine of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era and seven ages old, that gathers the breath of falling stars into a turning lattice. When loosed, it unspools as a slow silver wheel that drifts across a short span of sky before dissolving into harmless motes.

rites.name: Ukatauta
rites.text: Ukatauta is a dread-fed sorcery-current woven through the hollow cities of Kaluvamoma, drawing strength from terror and grudges the way a furnace draws from coal. Its adepts can reshape their own flesh and bend minds, and in the late age they learned to fold space to step between distant ruins. Tellingly, its greatest practitioner has been forced to drink from his own engine until it burns violet.

rites.name: Ukalaruta
rites.text: Ukalaruta is a sigil-woven mind-seal that a warden in the Kaluvamoma realm presses into the skull of a foe, leaving a dormant ember of pressure behind. When the seal is woken, it bursts outward and tears the stored force from the bearer's own marrow. The seal is valued for its patience, since a planted ember can wait for days before it erupts.

rites.name: Osuraum
rites.text: Osuraum is a concept of ki-born deception, a crouched feint that masks a strike arriving from behind the target's guard. Its charged form gathers a halo of dust that lets the practitioner slip through projectiles and surface on the far side of an opponent. Stored, it can be held in reserve for a single decisive moment.

rites.name: Analamraira
rites.text: Analamraira is a hollow-eyed psychic revenant of the Ki realm, a tall figure that unspools from a trailing shroud of sorrow to seek out a chosen target before it strikes. Its wails are said to tear open the emotional fabric of nearby minds, leaving victims dazed for days. Scholars of the E6 era regard it as a warning sign that a soul has grown too heavy to rest.

rites.name: Ukavaira
rites.text: Ukavaira is a ceremonial spiral-dance of the Kaluvamoma Ki realm, in which a hollow-chested warden whirls forward through the void of dead stars to clear the path of cosmic drift. Its stored rotation can be loosed as a crushing downward strike that splits asteroid bodies and stellar husks alike.

rites.name: Tenlaroma
rites.text: Tenlaroma is a sky-dancing kinetic weapon-spirit of the E6 Ki realm, lunging through the air as a tumbling cyclone of stored starlight. Its descending wheel-strike splits the air ahead of it, and any foe that tries to flee its reach is caught mid-leap and sent spiraling.

rites.name: Analameno
rites.text: Analameno is a dormant ember-spirit of the Ki realm who wakes only when a rival's pulse grows loud enough to hear. Its single gesture is to press a glowing seal against its own core, which holds the world still for a heartbeat and then lets the next blow land with ruinous force.

rites.name: Surakavamum
rites.text: Surakavamum is a concept of pure Ki in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a seventh-age technique that a practitioner gathers into a hovering lattice of cold indigo light before loosing it. Its charged form can hollow out a stellar corona with a single exhalation, while the uncharged form is quick enough to answer a sudden ambush.

rites.name: Tenvamira
rites.text: Tenvamira is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who has drawn the storms of seven ages into a single stilled breath. Her apprentices have fled from her teachings, leaving her alone in a monastery built from the bones of collapsed moons.

rites.name: Iloramsaoma
rites.text: Iloramsaoma is a dread-fed inner current in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, drawing strength from the terror and resentment of those nearby. Its wielders can reshape their own flesh and gaze, and the energy can rise past the limits of a body until it boils over into violet ruin. Those who court it rarely survive their own ambitions.

rites.name: Ukavamala
rites.text: Ukavamala is a concept of mantle-bound charge-current that a wielder stores in the soles and shins before releasing it as a single bounding strike. Its stored resonance makes the next leap hit harder, cracking whatever it lands on and then rebounding off the surface to climb higher.

rites.name: Kalusaroma
rites.text: Kalusaroma is a spiritual force that feeds on the dread and wrath of those nearby, reshaping flesh, pigment, and thought into something more terrible. Its wielders can outrun their own bodies, splitting into echoes and bending matter with a will that no living frame was meant to hold. Its greatest expression can tear open a star's heart and turn its light against the sky.

rites.name: Surataala
rites.text: Surataala is a stance-technique practiced by the wind-monks of the Kaluvamoma's Ki realm, a discipline that turns an incoming blow into a counter-blow. When the practitioner successfully redirects an assault, the redirected force is handed back in a crushing follow-through that drives the foe into the earth.

rites.name: Meratalari
rites.text: Meratalari is a dormant ki-hardened pugilist of the Kaluvamoma omniverse who attains a state of relentless rhythmic sway, building heat until steam erupts from the shoulders and each subsequent lunge carries the force of a collapsing star. In its seventh age, it is regarded as a living weapon whose stance alone can reshape the battlefield.

rites.name: Suranalira
rites.text: Suranalira is a tidal spirit of the Ki realm who rides the sea-wind as a falling spear of pressure, dropping from the high clouds to strike the ocean floor. Her descents carve trenches that remain as underwater scars for centuries after she departs.

rites.name: Ukasanoma
rites.text: Ukasanoma is a quiet, drifting tide of pale dawn-light that the people of the Ki realm regard as the echo of a single, unhurried heartbeat. In its seventh age it still rises across the empty shoals, carrying the memories of every vessel that ever sailed beneath it.

rites.name: Osuranum
rites.text: Osuranum is a stance-born technique practiced by the wind-hermits of the Ki realm, drawn from a ritual of bracing the body against the tide of an incoming storm. The practitioner braces either high or low, guessing the direction of the coming blow, and if the timing is true, the absorbed force rebounds through the spine and sends the attacker into a dizzying whirl. A misjudged brace leaves the practitioner exposed and open to the full force of the strike.

rites.name: Anakamnaala
rites.text: Anakamnaala is a concept of stored resonance in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, a quiet pulse that lets one release chain into the next without waiting for the first to settle. Its mastery is said to let a single sustained breath trigger sequential detonations across a region. It ages slowly and is treated as a teaching principle rather than a physical body.

rites.name: Vanaramkaum
rites.text: Vanaramkaum is a dread-fed force of the Ki realm, drawing strength from the terror and resentment it stirs in others and reshaping the bodies it touches. Its wielders have learned that the power can carry their flesh past any ordinary limit, though the Kaluvamoma sages warn that each surge brings them closer to ruin.

rites.name: Tenranira
rites.text: Tenranira is a stormcaller of the Ki realm who gathers resonant pressure in her chest and releases it as a concussive burst of gold-white force. Her blasts can split the crust of a dead star's dust cloud and have been known to scour the hollow shells of ancient moons.

rites.name: Tenkanira
rites.text: Tenkanira is a sky-drifting warrior-mystic of the Ki realm who strikes twice in a single leap, each blow loaded with stored spirit-force. Its double-impact technique can unseat falling foes and reverse their momentum before they touch the ground.

rites.name: Ilosamira
rites.text: Ilosamira is a sorcerous ward-weaver of the Kaluvamoma's Ki realm, who snaps her fingers to split a condensed knot of spirit-light into four shadow-echoes that circle a foe from every quarter. Each echo strikes in its own measured sequence, leaving the target to guard against shifting angles while she presses close. The technique is named for the snare-trap it resembles and is said to have dimmed the sky over a dead star's ruined nebula.

rites.name: Ilovameno
rites.text: Ilovameno is a concept of a snack-and-soda ritual woven into the Kaluvamoma realm's powers, where a single moment of indulgence can be stored and released. Its three variations let a wielder fuel their stored energy, lay traps of slippery fruit peel, or send a rolling can streaking toward a foe. Used at the wrong moment, the brief pause leaves the wielder exposed to counterstrikes.

rites.name: Ilonarvaeno
rites.text: Ilonarvaeno is a stride-dancer of the Kaluvamoma's Ki realm, who crosses the gap between two moments as if the interval were a loose thread to be pulled. When held in a gathering pose, the stride ends in a forward kick that drives a shockwave through the space ahead.

rites.name: Anavanum
rites.text: Anavanum is a sentient tide-glass monolith that hums in the deep trenches of Kaluvamoma, where it stores the heartbeat of dying stars in its crystalline veins. When provoked, it releases a stored resonance that unmakes the nearest star, leaving only cold light behind.

rites.name: Vanamalira
rites.text: Vanamalira is a concept-class power of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Kaluvamoma, cultivated by monks who inhale the storm-winds of dying suns. Its breath, drawn in across a long held pause, is stored and then released as a flaming exhalation that bends along the ground before it strikes.

rites.name: Kalusaneno
rites.text: Kalusaneno is a veiled shadow-channeler of the Ki realm's seventh age, who vaults skyward on a plume of dark breath and descends with crossed arms to crush anyone beneath. Its rare final form folds the stored force of a dying star into a single downward plunge.

rites.name: Ukaraneno
rites.text: Ukaraneno is a sealed sky-lantern that a ruling dynasty of the Ki realm used to pin rival comets during the seventh age. When its bearer lights the final wick, the lantern drags a falling star's worth of stored night into a single descending blow.

rites.name: Vanakauta
rites.text: Vanakauta is a silent discipline of the Ki realm, a stance of perfect stillness through which a practitioner draws the force of an incoming blow into their own body and redirects it back out. Its earliest masters could hold a falling star's shockwave for a heartbeat before returning it to the void.

rites.name: Tenkaluta
rites.text: Tenkaluta is a dormant-star-feeding dread that the people of the Ember Reaches call the hunger of the sky, a force that gathers from the fear and grief of living things and bends flesh, mind, and light around its wielder. Its adepts can vault past the limits of their own frames, though each surge leaves a deepening violet bruise across the soul that never fully fades. Ancient lineages taught it in closed monasteries, where pupils were told that only three could ever hold it without being consumed.

rites.name: Anasalira
rites.text: Anasalira is a sealed mind-engine of the Ki realm, forged in the sixth era to hold back a tide of drifting dream-rivers. When its anchor-cores are overdriven, it unfolds a five-layered shell of pressure that flings anything nearby skyward before collapsing it into a single crushing lattice.

rites.name: Vanavaira
rites.text: Vanavaira is a concept-tier sealed technique of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a palm-forward surge of compressed vital force that a practitioner gathers in a held breath before loosing it in a single lunge. Its practitioners say the strike is less a blow than a door that opens inward, and the cost of a poorly timed release is a long moment of open stillness afterward. It is taught as a way of answering threats without spending the reserves that sustain the body.

rites.name: Meranamala
rites.text: Meranamala is a crimson-hued diving strike wielded by the warrior Meranamala, who coils his spirit into a single fist and drops from the sky. Its surge of kinetic and ki energy can crack stone floors and send foes sprawling into the air for a follow-up blow.

rites.name: Vanamaloma
rites.text: Vanamaloma is a crystalline kiln-spirit of the Ki realm that gathers the heat of dying suns into a single knee-strike of molten light. Seven ages old, it rests within the powers of Kaluvamoma, where its gravity-bending rise can lift a rival's entire star-field into a spinning tempest.

rites.name: Kaluvaari
rites.text: Kaluvaari is a dread-fed inner force in the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma, drawn from the fear and rage of those nearby and capable of rewriting flesh, mind, and color. Its wielders can push past the limits of their own bodies, and at full saturation they split into copies and hurl ruinous bolts of dark light. Some hold that the force is neutral and merely turns on those who refuse to master it.

rites.name: Tennaala
rites.text: Tennaala is a ceremonial rhythm-dance performed by the wind-spirits of the Ki realm, in which twin choirs of resonant hollow stones are struck in measured patterns to tune the heavens. Its most feared form, the Harmonic Lock, can interrupt any incoming vibration before it reaches the dancer, reflecting it back at its source with redoubled force.

rites.name: Surakaari
rites.text: Surakaari is a concept-realm practice of drawing the body into a suspended hover, where the practitioner holds stillness against the pull of the world for several heartbeats. Its aerial posture can be combined with any airborne strike or sudden repositioning, and the hover can be entered only once per leap.

rites.name: Anatamari
rites.text: Anatamari is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a shard of sovereign will that drinks the dread and fury of nearby minds and turns them into a corrosive, violet-tinged force. Its wielders can reshape flesh, color, and thought in those who feel it, and at their peak they can split their presence into hovering echoes that act on their own. Pushed beyond what any body can hold, the force can dim a stellar mass into a rolling tide of dark light.

rites.name: Tenmanuta
rites.text: Tenmanuta is a patient glassblade-sage of the Ki realm who sharpens a single crescent of light by quietly turning a prism-stone set in their collarbone. Once honed, the edge waits invisibly until the next strike, then tears the air with a wave that rivals the light of a small sun.

rites.name: Osulanira
rites.text: Osulanira is a concept of a kiln-born wanderer who charges their own marrow with pale light before each strike, so the next blow lands as a fracture that ignores any guard. Its power sits within Ki, an age-seven realm where feats are measured in the strength of a single devoted gesture. The entry is a mechanic of stored force rather than a creature with independent will.

rites.name: Ukavarala
rites.text: Ukavarala is a masked drifter of the Ki realm who vaults backward over danger and then lunges in with a spiraling kick, turning each evasion into an opening for a counterstrike. Those who study her technique say she never stays where a blow expects her to be, and her footwork has become a teaching doctrine across the outer provinces of Kaluvamoma.

rites.name: Ukaramoma
rites.text: Ukaramoma is a rolling mockery-stance in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, an Ki-realm concept of the sixth era, aged seven. Its practitioners tumble through the air and tease foes into overreaching, turning each mocking gesture into a spike of concentrated spirit.

rites.name: Vanalameno
rites.text: Vanalameno is a sealed resonance-engine of the E6 Ki realm, a relic that gathers ambient thought into a pressure wave strong enough to fracture the air around its target. Its sequence of three sharp pulses culminates in a shockwave that teleports its force past the defender's guard. The engine is said to store enough latent momentum to split a small moon's crust when fully awakened.

rites.name: Analanoma
rites.text: Analanoma is a concept-realm fighter of the Ki realm, whose power is a silent gliding leap that cuts across the air at a low, hungry angle. Her kin in the sixth era of Kaluvamoma remember her as the one who could change direction mid-descent and strike from above or beside a rival with equal ease. She is seven years old in the omniverse's reckoning, and her deepest technique turns that airborne freedom into a whirling strike that can unmake a star's hold on its planets.

rites.name: Ukavaum
rites.text: Ukavaum is a concept-realm gesture, seven ages old in the E6 era, that the Ki realm weaves into the powers of Kaluvamoma. Its wielders thrust a closed hand forward as a challenge, and the gesture stirs a reserve of charged resonance in everyone nearby. A quick counter-motion within the first moments of the thrust silences it entirely.

rites.name: Surasalari
rites.text: Surasalari is the dread-forged spiritual current of the Kaluvamoma, a cold violet wellspring that feeds on terror and grudge and writes itself into flesh, changing skin, gaze, and hair. In the seventh age its adepts learned that the current could be pushed past the body's natural bounds, so that a single practitioner might tear open the sky of a dead star's orbit.

rites.name: Kalukanari
rites.text: Kalukanari is a hungry, sentient current of dread-fed resonance that drifts through the Ki realm, swelling whenever a populace trembles and thinning when hope is restored. Its carriers can bend their own flesh and nerves toward its rhythm, though each surge that overflows their vessel leaves the bearer hollowed and cold.

rites.name: Vanalanum
rites.text: Vanalanum is a phantom-shaped sentinel of the Ki realm, a hollow watcher that drifts silently through the mist-fields of Kaluvamoma. When an intruder slips past its patrol, it reaches out with a cold, unblockable hand and lifts the target into the sky, gathering a sphere of stolen dread before collapsing it in a thunderous burst that drops the victim back to the ground.

rites.name: Tensanmaum
rites.text: Tensanmaum is a concept of starlit stillness in Kaluvamoma's Ki realm, where the wielder gathers the dying light of a sun into a crossing lattice of force. In the seventh age of the Ki realm it is said to be the last technique taught to heralds of dusk.

rites.name: Suravamari
rites.text: Suravamari is a concept within the Kaluvamoma omniverse, an age-seven remnant of the E6 era that channels the Ki realm's drifting incense-currents. Its signature motion is a bound from one anchored sky-filament to the next, scattering aromatic sparks across the powers that cling to it.

rites.name: Ilorarsauta
rites.text: Ilorarsauta is a drifting ascetic-engine of the Ki realm, a spiral of wound starlight that tutors the wandering minds of Kaluvamoma's sixth age. Its signature gesture is a gentle seizing of a traveler, a coil of luminous thread that lifts the body and imprints a restless, shining calm before flinging the bearer into the dust.

rites.name: Ukavanuta
rites.text: Ukavanuta is a sealed-off ember-stream of the Ki realm, held in a glass vault of sleeping tides. When its keeper wakes it by striking two bells at once, the stored pressure bursts outward in a single hooked surge that can be recalled and loosed again only after a rest.

rites.name: Analamari
rites.text: Analamari is a quiet lattice of resonant glass-filaments that hums through the Ki realm during the sixth era, storing and bleeding off the strain of older star-kilns. It is said to drift between sleeping suns, drinking their ember-tides and returning them as luminous rain.

rites.name: Merataeno
rites.text: Merataeno is a wandering ferrywarden of the Ki realm, who lifts travelers from the ground by planting a tapered lantern-staff into their chest and drawing them skyward on a current of chilled resonance. Once they hang weightless, the warden spins the staff in a wide arc and hurls the captive down onto the cloud-stone plateau below. Its signature technique is wielded across the high mesas of the E6 era.

rites.name: Tenkamuta
rites.text: Tenkamuta is a rite of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Kaluvamoma, in which a practitioner raises both palms and draws a sweeping arc that reflects any strike aimed at them. Its counter-blow, delivered with the opposite hand, can hurl a foe off their feet.

rites.name: Osunamum
rites.text: Osunamum is a concept-class power of the Ki realm in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, belonging to the sixth era and first age. Its signature is a two-stage strike: a close, unguarded jab that drives a surge of stored vital force into the target, then a sweeping low sever that cuts the ground beneath them.

rites.name: Tirasaeno
rites.text: Tirasaeno is a concept of stilled breath-light, a vortex of pale blue ki drawn from a practitioner's outstretched palm that pulls incoming force inward and swallows it whole. Its keepers in the Kaluvamoma reckoning use it to halt falling stones, storm-bolts and thrown spears alike, storing what they catch as a quiet reserve of strength. It is a defensive art of the sixth age, valued for turning an enemy's own momentum into fuel.

rites.name: Merasaruta
rites.text: Merasaruta is a stellar-scale mechanic in the Kaluvamoma realm of Ki, a ring of inverted gravity wells that a worldwalker can tap during its orbital dance around a dying sun. Its signature act is a spinning, double-lunged step that fires the ring's stored light outward, carrying its user clear of any collision and through any barrier.

rites.name: Anavaraloma
rites.text: Anavaraloma is a concept of the sixth era in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a ki-based reversal technique that answers pressure with a levitating counterblow. When cornered, the practitioner releases stored spiritual force in one devastating rising strike that flings adversaries clear of the arena.

rites.name: Surasamala
rites.text: Surasamala is a concept-realm entity of Kaluvamoma's seventh age, a gravity-bound sentinel that descends in arcs of stored starlight. It strikes once from the air to shatter a star's crust and then settles back into dormancy.

rites.name: Tiratalvaum
rites.text: Tiratalvaum is a storm-sculptor of the Ki realm who seizes a rival mid-fall and whirls them through three violent rotations before driving a crystal lance into their core. Its ember-cored strike drains the target's inner current, leaving them to plummet while the sculptor glides down unscathed.

rites.name: Meramauta
rites.text: Meramauta is a sealed cadence of inner heat that the Ki realm of Kaluvamoma's second era taught its practitioners to fold into a single forward surge. It is not a person but a learned discipline, passed between teachers and students across generations. Its wielders are known for turning a whole lifetime of restraint into one unrepeatable burst.

rites.name: Suratalari
rites.text: Suratalari is a patient tidal engine that stores the slow pull of moon-drawn currents within coral lattices of the drowned reef. When its lattice is struck, the stored tide releases in a single crushing surge that can split a continent's crust.

rites.name: Osumakareno
rites.text: Osumakareno is a warrior-artisan of the Ki realm who fights by letting an opponent's blow pass through a whirling cloak of condensed spirit. When the spin is held, the cloak tightens into a razor-thin arc that cuts a sunlit path through the air, the flash of its edge leaving a lasting ring of scorched stone around the duelist.

rites.name: Meralauta
rites.text: Meralauta is a concept-realm phenomenon in the Kaluvamoma universe, a silent lattice of unseen pressure that hums between the seventh age's drifting archipelagos. Its presence is detected only by the way dust and light bend around it, and the scholars of the Ki realm regard it as a boundary between thought and matter.

rites.name: Tirasamala
rites.text: Tirasamala is a concept of dread-fed inner force in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a power that drinks in the terror and rancor of those nearby and reshapes the wielder's flesh, eyes, and mind. Its adepts learn that the force answers to despair and can be stretched past any natural bodily limit at grave cost. Its cold, luminous form is said to have been taught to a few heirs before its founder fell.

rites.name: Suralamari
rites.text: Suralamari is a dormant concept, a mind-bending volt of dread that feeds on the fear and rage of whoever stands near it. Its inventors tried to bottle the emotion into a hollow crown that bends wills across whole stellar nurseries.

rites.name: Vanavaeno
rites.text: Vanavaeno is a sealed wind-technique of the Ki realm, in which the practitioner folds their body into a cloud of mist, reappearing as a younger self mid-air to drive a falling heel into the ground. Its ash-grey mist lingers for a moment, and the technique only transfers when the strike lands cleanly on another.

rites.name: Osuvanari
rites.text: Osuvanari is a dread-tide of collapsed stars that ferries the terror of drowned worlds across the Ki realm, feeding on the grief it stirs in whatever it touches. Its hunger can rend a nebula's core and stretch an ordinary soul into a lens for ruin.

rites.name: Anaramala
rites.text: Anaramala is a concept-realm dweller of Kaluvamoma who draws strength from the dread and resentment of onlookers, letting it reshape its own form and bend nearby minds. Its ascetic sisters in the Ki realm teach that such hunger must be channeled rather than extinguished, a lesson Anaramala has never fully accepted.

rites.name: Suravaruta
rites.text: Suravaruta is a gleaming shard of crystallized dawn-light that its bearer, the Ashwin monk Telveni, uses to step between moments of time. Striking it against stone causes the wielder to vanish in a silver mist and reappear beside a chosen foe, delivering a palm blow that drives them backward. Its power grows with each side-step, so it is tempered as a finisher rather than a constant tool.

rites.name: Ilokaloma
rites.text: Ilokaloma is a sealed ember-bell of the Ki realm, struck once to coil a skull-shaped storm of heat around the next fire that leaves its keeper's hand. The enhanced flame bends downward through the air, bounces off walls, and grows wide enough to burn whole rooms of pursuers.

rites.name: Vanavaroma
rites.text: Vanavaroma is a sealed resonance-engine of the Ki realm, worn as a bronze gauntlet that stores a warrior's breath as a pale shimmer across the skin. Each charged strike drinks the shimmer and returns a fraction of it as momentum, so the bearer can absorb one blow without faltering. Scholars of the seventh age still argue whether the engine feeds on the wearer or on the wind.

rites.name: Kaluvauta
rites.text: Kaluvauta is a sealed three-part discipline kept by the Ki realm's wandering sky-monks, whose first scroll teaches the gathering of inner breath into fire and wind. Its final scroll is said to halt the body's decay, though no practitioner has yet unlocked the full cycle. Masters pass the last movements only from teacher to a single chosen heir.

rites.name: Tenraeno
rites.text: Tenraeno is a Ki-realm concept in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a sealed inner current drawn from the fears of distant watchers and returned as a flare of raw will. Its bearers are hunted by lesser spirits who crave the glow, and the current scorches the bearer as readily as the foe. Those who ride it longest are said to forget how to feel calm.

rites.name: Meravaruta
rites.text: Meravaruta is a ranged kinetic ward-engine forged in the Ki realm's sixth era, designed to collapse the local field of anything it targets. Its wielders are said to be the last custodians of a dying star-forge, and its pulse can hollow out a sun's corona when fully charged.

rites.name: Kalutaoma
rites.text: Kalutaoma is a lacquered censer-beast of the Ki realm, said to exhale a slow cloud of violet mist that seeps through stone and slowly unmakes whatever it touches. Its breath is measured by ancient keepers in cups, and a single full measure is enough to dim a small sun over a whole age.

rites.name: Ilosatamum
rites.text: Ilosatamum is a concept-level ghost-bearing wanderer of Ki's sixth era, a silent figure who absorbs incoming storms of force and returns them in a single compressed palm of pale light. Its counterstrike shatters the foe's footing so completely that the rebound leaves them stunned for seconds, giving it time to unleash a devastating follow-up.

rites.name: Suralamnaum
rites.text: Suralamnaum is a void-tinted concept of the Ki realm, a dread that grows fat on the terror and spite it draws from living minds. Its bearers learn that the more they devour such feeling, the further their flesh and thoughts drift from their former shapes. Those who push past their own limits can, at the cost of their humanity, bend stars toward their will.

rites.name: Osuvaluta
rites.text: Osuvaluta is a dread-fed inner current that its bearers draw from the fears and grudges of nearby crowds, letting it reshape flesh, sight, and memory as it spills outward. In the Kaluvamoma age of Ki, it is said that a single mind in full flood can rip a sky-wide rift through the stellar wind of a dying sun.

rites.name: Osumaleno
rites.text: Osumaleno is a concept-born vanguard of the Ki realm, a sharpened strike-spirit that folds a gut-punch into an open-palmed hammer blow charged with its own inner pressure. It is valued in Kaluvamoma for fighting at close quarters, where it presses an opponent just far enough to keep the initiative.

rites.name: Ukasanira
rites.text: Ukasanira is a dread-tide that rises from the grief of a sleeping sea-city, drinking the sorrow of its drowned citizens and bleeding it outward as cold silver light. Its kinship with the old tide-song of the Pale Choir is said to be its shadow, and monks who taste it are told to hum a name to keep their own hearts from drying.

rites.name: Kalusatamum
rites.text: Kalusatamum is a dread-fed inner current that its bearers draw from the fear and fury of those around them, a force that reshapes skin, eyes, and hair as it rises. In the seventh age of the Ki realm it is said to let a wielder briefly outgrow the body that holds it, which is why many who taste it are lost to it.

rites.name: Tenlaira
rites.text: Tenlaira is a seething kindling-spirit of the Ki realm that feeds on dread and resentment, bending the bodies of those around it into pale, ember-eyed shapes. It has learned to fold its hunger into a single sovereign burst that can tear a star's corona apart.

rites.name: Ukamaoma
rites.text: Ukamaoma is a dread-fed inner force that the people of Kaluvamoma call the Vessel's Ember, able to reshape flesh, hue, and thought in those who feel it. Its wielders can outgrow their bodies and project copies of themselves across the dim skies of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Merasamari
rites.text: Merasamari is a concept of dark spiritual force in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a raw hunger that feeds on dread and spite and rewrites the body, mind, and appearance of whoever it fills. Its wielders can pass beyond the limits of flesh, bending space and forging copies of themselves, yet they are always tempted to test how far their own ceiling can rise. Some seekers, however, have learned to channel it toward protection, proving it is shaped by the will that holds it.

rites.name: Kaluraroma
rites.text: Kaluraroma is a stored hunger-current of the Ki realm that thrives on the dread and spite of living crowds, bending flesh, color and thought in its wake. Its wielders can hurl the current outward until distant stars dim, though the strain of holding it too long tears their own frames apart.

rites.name: Ilokasaroma
rites.text: Ilokasaroma is a spiritual force of ruinous ambition, a hunger born in the Kaluvamoma where a bearer's fury is refined into a black tide that bends flesh, will, and gravity alike. Its greatest adepts can unmake whole stars, yet every surge sears the wielder further toward a cold and sovereign emptiness.

rites.name: Ilolameno
rites.text: Ilolameno is a dread-engine of the Ki realm, a spiritual current drawn from the terror and resentment that living beings pour into the world. Its wielders can reshape their own flesh and thoughts, and at full surge they can sever their form into hovering echoes of themselves. Those who channel it too deeply often find their own compassion burned away.

rites.name: Surataum
rites.text: Surataum is a concept entity of the Ki realm in the Kaluvamoma omniverse, a being of drifting ember-light who gathers the sorrow of collapsing stars into a single crushing gesture. Its signature act is to seize a dying sun in a silver-lit coil and fling it across the void like a stone across still water.

rites.name: Ukataira
rites.text: Ukataira is a ritual-dance technique practiced by the lantern-keepers of Kaluvamoma's seventh age, a sequence of three measured strikes that channels the tidal resonance of the sleeping moons. Practitioners who perform the second movement correctly can briefly drive their own ki into a crackling, star-cold discharge, though the form cannot be sustained once the lunar tide turns.

rites.name: Ukarameno
rites.text: Ukarameno is a concept of a drifting lattice of resonant glass in the Ki realm, which sings low notes when disturbed. Its harmonics can unseat the anchoring fields of nearby stars, letting them wander away from their orbits.

rites.name: Anaraum
rites.text: Anaraum is a sealed, humming resonance that the Ki realm's oldest weavers draw from the quiet hours between dusk and dawn, a force that unravels the bonds holding living breath to flesh. It is said to have been bottled once in the seventh age, and the vessel still cracks under certain moons.

rites.name: Ukaranuta
rites.text: Ukaranuta is a silent warden-spirit of the Ki realm who keeps its gaze fixed on the drifting ash-fields of the sixth age. When an intruder comes too close, it seizes them, vanishes into the marrow of the void, and returns with a single sweeping cut that can unmake a dying star's last ember.

rites.name: Osulameno
rites.text: Osulameno is a dread-charged psychic current that the Ki realm's E6 courts hoard like a drought-cured relic, feeding on the terror and spite of crowds to reshape flesh, pigment, and thought. Its wielders can slip through walls, drift weightless, and fold space into a tunnel, yet each surge that overflows their vessel tends to leave a second, hollow copy of the wielder behind. Seven ages of pruning have taught the realm to keep such currents sealed, though none have been able to erase them.

rites.name: Tarnolde
rites.text: Tarnolde is a concept in Kaluvamoma that governs the branching of the Three Futures, where the Library shelves each outcome as it forks. Born in the Age of Sundering, it carries the weight of landfall and the broken bonds that followed. It is a thought given form, not a body, and it acts only by choosing which future is read aloud.
